expected.note: dpsFixed = combined total (drone+turret+fixed), matching the tool own displayed Total DPS stat. Cross-checked against a prior session independent manual calc + the real tool own reported output for this exact killmail: target DPS ~422 (379 drone + 43 turret), EHP 19644. This entry specifically catches: (1) RESISTANCE_BONUS_ATTR x100 bug -- totalHP/droneDps are exact matches to the previously-recorded real numbers; (2) sentry/combat drone bonus double-counting -- droneDps=379 exact match confirms only the 50% combat bonus applies (no sentries in this bay). Turret-only DPS: after the 2026-09-10 turret/missile DPS fix (weapon-size-class Small Hybrid Turret skill +25%/V damage, Gunnery V RoF), went from ~31 to ~40 against a ~43 target (72%->93%) -- dpsFixed now 419 (379 drone + ~40 turret) vs a combined target of ~422, essentially matching. Range tightened to 410-430 to reflect this. UPDATE 2026-09-10 (later same day): a real pyfa-verified Osprey Navy Issue fit exposed a general bug -- every combat drone carries its own intrinsic damageMultiplier attribute (64, the same attribute a turret charge multiplier already used) that the drone DPS calc was never applying at all. Fixing it took the Osprey drone DPS from 47 to 79 against a pyfa target of 86.6 (91% -- the same ~90% residual band seen everywhere else in this project), and, as an unavoidable side effect, changed this Ishtar fits droneDps from 379 to 611 (its 3 drone types -- Berserker II 1.56x, Acolyte II 1.68x, Caldari Navy Vespa 1.8x -- all carry a non-1 multiplier that was previously silently dropped). The old 379 figure was only ever checked against this tools OWN prior (pre-fix) output on this killmail, never independently against pyfa, so it was not a real validation of drone DPS -- the new 611 is now believed more correct, per the same standard used throughout this project (validated directly against an independent real pyfa export, on the Osprey). Range widened rather than pinned exact since no independent pyfa target exists for this specific Ishtar drone bay. Also catches the Drone Control Range ship-role-bonus path (F2 half, Phase 5, added 2026-10-11): Ishtar carries a genuine Heavy Assault Cruisers elite-bonus effect (1084) adding +5000m/level (25000 at V) directly, confirmed live via ESI effect bodies -- droneControlRangeTotal=65000 (20000 base + 20000 universal skill V + 0 module, no DLA fitted here + 25000 ship bonus). UPDATE 2026-10-11 (comprehensive skill audit, P1-B): drone DPS multiplier corrected -- the RoF reduction previously applied (-20%, attributed to '[Race] Drone Specialization') was fictional, no drone RoF skill exists at all; that skill is actually a +10%@V DAMAGE bonus gated to T2 drones (reqSkill-detected), and a separate, previously entirely unmodeled weapon-size-class damage skill (+25%@V, Light/Medium/Heavy Drone Operation or Sentry Drone Interfacing, always applies) was added. Net real multiplier for a T1 drone is unchanged (1.50x1.25=1.875, same magnitude as the old 1.50/0.80 by coincidence); for a T2 drone it's 1.50x1.25x1.10=2.0625, ~10% higher than before. UPDATE 2026-10-11 (independent review pass, finding #2): maxActiveDrones (attribute 352) was discovered to be a CHARACTER attribute, not a ship one -- confirmed live via ESI's own attribute metadata and the absence of 352 from every checked ship's dogma_attributes -- so the old Infinity fallback was never actually a fallback at all; it was the value used on EVERY fit, unconditionally. Fixed to the correct fixed cap of 5 (MAX_ACTIVE_DRONES_SKILL_V, from the Drones skill's own description: 'Can operate 1 drone per skill level', assumed trained to V per this tool's established convention). This fit's drone bay held more than 5 combat-capable drones, so it was previously crediting more active drones than a pilot can actually control -- the corrected sandbox output (droneCount now exactly 5, greedily filled hardest-hitting-type-first, same already-audited per-drone formula) is the new expected value. Sandbox: droneCount=5 of 14 bay (4x Berserker II + 1x Caldari Navy Vespa deployed, Acolyte II crowded out -- hardest-hitting-first greedy fill), droneDps=554, dpsFixed=598. UPDATE 2026-10-11 (independent review pass, finding #6): MAX_DRONE_AVIONICS_BONUS was 5000 (a flat 1-level value) instead of 25000 (5000m/level x5, confirmed live via ESI description text for Drone Avionics -- "Drone control range increased by 5000 meters per skill level"), contradicting this constant's own adjacent code comment. Fixed; droneControlRangeTotal rises by the missing 20000m on every ship. 2026-10-12 addendum: this fit's Republic Fleet Large Cap Battery + 2x Capacitor Flux Coil were never read by the capacitor calc before today's fix (the owner: "are you accounting for cap batteries?") -- capacitorCapacity was 1750/stablePct 79.1 pre-fix (bare-hull-only), now 2660/94.6 post-fix (capacity now within ~3% of pyfa's real reported 2580 GJ for this exact fit). stablePct/netRate still diverge further from pyfa's own reported 40.5%/+7.12 GJ/s for this fit than capacity does -- most likely this fit's cached Flux Coil dogma stubs (fetched for the unrelated 2026-10-12 Nosferatu work, never verified for capacitor purposes) and/or the the owner-chosen EVE-client closed-form stability model's own disclosed divergence from pyfa's full discrete-event sim on a fit dominated by one large lumpy shield-booster drain (see the original capacitor-stability-model fix log entry) -- flagged to the owner, not yet fully resolved. UPDATE 2026-10-13 (v2026.10.13.10, unpenalized cap/shield pools): capacitorCapacity 2660 -> 2576. pyfa's capacitorCapacityMultiply / modifyPowerRechargeRate / shieldCapacityMultiply / modifyShieldRechargeRate handlers (Capacitor Power Relay, Power Diagnostic System, Capacitor Flux Coil, Shield Flux Coil, Shield Power Relay, Capacitor Recharger, Shield Recharger) pass no stackingPenalties flag, so these multipliers are NOT stacking-penalized; the 2026-10-12 implementation penalized them. 2576 vs pyfa's real 2580 for this exact fit (0.15%) -- the old ~3% capacity gap is closed. stablePct/netRate untouched by this change. UPDATE 2026-10-13 (v2026.10.13.20, module states Phase 1): Assault Damage Control II now defaults ONLINE (its active Effect7012 is a short burst; its passive Effect2302 resists still apply), so its 35 GJ / 10.125 s = 3.46 GJ/s no longer counts: 8.7 -> 5.2. Stable % from the closed form with peak 84.3: 100 x ((1 + sqrt(1 - 5.2/84.3)) / 2)^2 = 96.9 (94.8 before). UPDATE 2026-10-14: the fixture lacked the Shield Booster GROUP record (40), so the engine dropped the X-Large C5-L Compact Shield Booster entirely; the real page fetches it and was right. Group added (run_regression.mjs now fails any fitted item without type+group records). Now matches the owner's pyfa screenshot exactly: stable 40.5% (pyfa 40.5%), net +7.1 (pyfa +7.12), drain 77.2 = booster 360 GJ / 5 s (Shield Compensation V) + hardeners 3.2 + 2.0; independent: tools/independent_checks/check_cap_sim.py (pyfa capSim). Shield booster 596 HP / 5 s = 119 HP/s.

expected.note: RESOLVED 2026-09-18: the 335.1 figure this range was built around was flagged in its own note as a "pyfa/memory" value, never a confirmed fresh pyfa export (unlike the other golden fits, which all quote a literal user-supplied pyfa screenshot/export). This fit exposed TWO real, previously-undiscovered bugs, both fixed the same day: (1) a UNIVERSAL Battleship role bonus (ESI effect 8377, confirmed identical on 9 different T1/navy battleship hulls including this one: +50% to Armor Plate's own flat armor HP, +100% to Shield Extender's own flat shield HP) was entirely unhandled -- every plated/shield-extended battleship fit was silently undercounting buffer HP. Fixed by reading the ship's own attributes 3266/3267 generically and applying them to Armor Plate / Shield Extender group items specifically. (2) Reactive Armor Hardener was modeled as a static flat 15%/15%/15%/15% armor resistance split (its own unsimulated dogma values folded straight into the same direct-multiply path Damage Control uses), when in real EVE (and in pyfa, whose eos/sim/reactive_armor_hardener.py was ported directly) it continuously shifts resistance from whichever damage type(s) it's taking the least of toward whichever it's taking the most, converging to a settled (or short-looping) state under an assumed damage profile. Ported pyfa's exact donor/recipient/loop-detection algorithm assuming a uniform (25% each type) incoming profile -- pyfa's own default -- and validated: converged resistances 75.1%/72.0%/71.5%/71.0% vs pyfa's reported 75%/71%/71%/71%, an almost exact match. Also uncovered along the way: DC II's own dogma attributes for its SHIELD resistance bonus (271-274, +12.5%) were transiently missing from an earlier browser-cached ESI fetch in this same investigation (a caching artifact, not a tool bug -- re-fetching with cache:'no-store' recovered the correct data). Utilizes a combination of containment field emitters and redundancy systems to mitigate the impact of critical system damage. 

Grants a bonus to resistance for shield, armor and hull.

Only one Damage Control can be fit at a given time.
2048.name: Damage Control II

2281.description:
Boosts shield resistance against all damage types.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module, or similar modules that affect the same resistance type, will result in a penalty to the boost you get on that type of resistance.
2281.name: Multispectrum Shield Hardener II

2404.description: Favored by many for its average capacity and firing rate. Useful in both fast attack raids and longer battles.
2404.name: Light Missile Launcher II

2410.description: Designed for long engagements between medium sized ships. Slow firing rate, but makes up for it with a large missile capacity.
2410.name: Heavy Missile Launcher II

2420.description: A massive launcher designed for extended bombardments of hard targets like battleships and stations. Contains a huge missile capacity, but has a slow firing rate and trouble targeting small, fast ships.
2420.name: Torpedo Launcher II

2629.description:
The Scourge heavy missile is an old relic from the Caldari-Gallente War that is still in widespread use because of its low price and versatility.

A modified version of the Scourge heavy missile. Does more damage than its predecessor but the volatile nature of the warhead, and its powerful containment system, reduce both flight time and precision.
2629.name: Scourge Fury Heavy Missile

3244.description: Disrupts the target ship's navigation computer which prevents it from warping.
3244.name: Warp Disruptor II

3841.description: Increases the maximum strength of the shield.
3841.name: Large Shield Extender II

10631.description: A tiny launcher that can carry a very limited supply of rockets. Not really intended as a primary weapon but rather as a cheap supplementary weapon system.
10631.name: Rocket Launcher II

11578.description:
A very specialized piece of technology, the covert ops cloak is designed for use in tandem with specific covert ops vessels. Although it could theoretically work on other ships, its spatial distortion field is so unstable that trying to compensate for its fluctuations will overwhelm non-specialized computing hardware. 

Note: This particular module is advanced enough that it allows a ship to warp while cloaked. However, fitting two or more cloaking devices to a ship negates their use, as unsynchronized light deflection causes interference.
11578.name: Covert Ops Cloaking Device II

13003.description: Neutralizes a portion of the energy in the target ship's capacitor.
13003.name: Small Energy Neutralizer II

15770.description:
Gives a boost to the maximum velocity of the ship when activated. The thrust that boosts the ship, and the corresponding maximum velocity bonus, are limited by the mass of the ship that uses this module.

Note: Usually fit on Battleships.
15770.name: Federation Navy 100MN Afterburner

17559.description: Reduces the maximum speed of a ship by employing micro energy streams which effectively entangle the target temporarily, thereby slowing it down.
17559.name: Federation Navy Stasis Webifier

19739.description: A battleship mounted launcher used for long range standoffs with other battleships, but less suitable for bombardment of deployed structures. Contains a huge missile capacity, but has a slow firing rate and trouble targeting small, fast ships.
19739.name: Cruise Missile Launcher II

20307.description: A kinetic warhead designed for use with heavy assault launchers. Heavy assault missiles can be fired at a greater rate than heavy missiles, at the expense of effective range.
20307.name: Scourge Heavy Assault Missile

22291.description:
A computer system designed for monitoring and guiding missiles in flight, thus allowing for superior effectiveness and lethality. 

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.
22291.name: Ballistic Control System II

24471.description:
A small rocket with a piercing warhead.

This modified version of the Scourge rocket packs a considerably stronger punch, but as a result is heavier and slower. This makes it very effective against larger targets, but markedly less effective against smaller and more agile targets.
24471.name: Scourge Rage Rocket

24477.description:
A small rocket with a piercing warhead.

A modified version of the Scourge rocket. It can reach higher velocity than the Scourge rocket at the expense of warhead size.
24477.name: Scourge Javelin Rocket

24495.description:
From its humble beginnings in tiny Minmatar design labs, the Scourge light missile has quickly established itself throughout the star cluster as a premier missile for light launchers.

A modified version of the Scourge light missile. Does more damage than its predecessor but the volatile nature of the warhead, and its powerful containment system, reduce both flight time and precision.
24495.name: Scourge Fury Light Missile

24501.description:
From its humble beginnings in tiny Minmatar design labs, the Scourge light missile has quickly established itself throughout the star cluster as a premier missile for light launchers.

A modified version of the Scourge light missile. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.
24501.name: Scourge Precision Light Missile

24513.description:
The Scourge heavy missile is an old relic from the Caldari-Gallente War that is still in widespread use because of its low price and versatility.

A modified version of the Scourge heavy missile. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.
24513.name: Scourge Precision Heavy Missile

24533.description:
The first Minmatar-made large missile. Constructed of reactionary alloys, the Scourge cruise missile is built to get to the target. Guidance and propulsion systems are of Gallente origin and were initially used in drones, making this a nimble projectile despite its heavy payload.

A modified version of the Scourge cruise. Does more damage than its predecessor but the volatile nature of the warhead, and its powerful containment system, reduce both flight time and precision.
24533.name: Scourge Fury Cruise Missile

24541.description:
The first Minmatar-made large missile. Constructed of reactionary alloys, the Scourge cruise missile is built to get to the target. Guidance and propulsion systems are of Gallente origin and were initially used in drones, making this a nimble projectile despite its heavy payload.

A modified version of the Scourge cruise. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.
24541.name: Scourge Precision Cruise Missile

25715.description: A launcher intended for use on cruiser-class spacecraft. While assault launchers do not possess the sheer damage-dealing capability of regular heavy missile launchers, their blend of speed and attack power lends them application across a good range of tactical situations.
25715.name: Heavy Assault Missile Launcher II

27435.description: First introduced by the armaments lab of the Wiyrkomi Corporation, the Mjolnir heavy missile is a solid investment with a large payload and steady performance.
27435.name: Caldari Navy Mjolnir Heavy Missile

27439.description: The Scourge heavy missile is an old relic from the Caldari-Gallente War that is still in widespread use because of its low price and versatility.
27439.name: Guristas Scourge Heavy Missile

28668.description:
A thick, heavy liquid, typically stored in tanks or container systems intended for liquids. It is composed of billions of nanites that can be programmed to repair damaged ship modules on the fly. The paste is simply applied to the damaged area, and the nanites meld into an exact copy of the damaged area, thus effecting repairs upon the module. This is a one-time process, as the nanites use themselves up along with the trace elements mixed into their carrier fluid.

The Repair Paste is generally only used for emergency on-site repairs. It is then recommended to have the damaged components looked at by a certified technician at first opportunity.
28668.name: Nanite Repair Paste

28756.description: Launcher for Core Scanner Probes and Combat Scanner Probes. Core Scanner Probes are used to scan down Cosmic Signatures in space. Combat Scanner Probes are used to scan down Cosmic Signatures, starships, structures and drones. Note: Only one scan probe launcher can be fitted per ship. 10% bonus to strength of scan probes.
28756.name: Sisters Expanded Probe Launcher

29990.description: For many Minmatar, the high mountains of Matar hold wonders unknown to the rest of New Eden: hidden glens, beautiful creatures, buried customs. Not surprisingly, the Krusual tribe lay claim to these mountains, their home for generations and base to their machinations. Krusual elders whisper ancient tales among their huddled tribes, describing the glory of heroes past and enigmatic prophecies of old. On the darkest day, at the most hopeless moments, an elder may speak of Loki, in reverent tones and excited hushes. In the ancient tongue, the Loki are the crux of Krusual thought. There is no direct translation for this word; in fact, Loki translates differently among the elders. It can mean “hidden wonder” or “secret passage”, “changing mask” or “unseen dagger”. Regardless of its context, Loki has one meaning common to all its tales across all the elders: “hope”.
29990.name: Loki

30486.description: A scanner probe used for scanning down Cosmic Signatures, starships, structures and drones. Can be launched from Expanded Probe Launchers.
30486.name: Sisters Combat Scanner Probe

30488.description: A scanner probe used for scanning down Cosmic Signatures in space. Can be launched from Core Probe Launchers and Expanded Probe Launchers.
30488.name: Sisters Core Scanner Probe

31360.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's powergrid capacity.
31360.name: Medium Ancillary Current Router I

31366.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's powergrid capacity.
31366.name: Medium Ancillary Current Router II

45595.description:
From the moment Strategic Cruisers became a reality, there were whispers amongst the scientific community about the potential for advances in cloaking technology. They remained that alone for the longest time, with few involved in the reverse engineering process willing to share any news of their discoveries. Everyone knew that, should the technology ever become a reality, the capabilities of the new Strategic Cruisers would change overnight.    

The Loki's Covert Reconfiguration designs arose out of a collective will to respond to what was thought to be Amarrian aggression deep inside their home regions. Unlike many scientific and technological breakthroughs, it was not the Sebiestor tribe alone who ushered in the paradigm shift to covert-capable Strategic Cruisers. It was only through consultation and collaboration with many other tribes and sub-factions that something substantial began to take shape. 

The Krusual and Thukker are said to have played the most important roles, however, in realizing the final design; the Thukker by providing the cloaking technology, and the Krusual by convincing them to do so. How they achieved this, or what they may have promised remains a secret; the two tribes are notorious for having many, and keeping them all.
45595.name: Loki Defensive - Covert Reconfiguration

45608.description: Adaptation and innovation go hand-in-hand, and this subsystem is a prime example of both ideas. While researching Sleeper drone weapon systems, a group of Minmatar engineers discovered that Sleeper launcher hardpoint design allowed for a vast increase to the rate of fire without increasing powergrid requirements. The resulting subsystem allows the Loki to achieve some of the most aggressive missile configurations seen on any cruiser.
45608.name: Loki Offensive - Launcher Efficiency Configuration

45621.description: This subsystem limits the wake left behind by a starship's microwarpdrive, allowing a pilot to maintain a lowered signature radius while still moving at high speed. The underlying design is based on the same technology used by smaller Sleeper drones and empire-produced Interceptors. Although the engineering processes behind wake limiters have existed for quite some time in the empires, their application in modular subsystems has only become a possibility after fullerene polymers became more widely available.
45621.name: Loki Propulsion - Wake Limiter

45633.description: Even millennia old, the technology employed by Sleeper drones is far from lacking. This is particularly true in the field of interdiction technology, where their capabilities often exceed contemporary systems. Consequently, this aspect of their fearsome arsenal has been the focus of much study and in some rare cases, the starting point for scientific breakthroughs. Minmatar researchers studied the long-range webification systems of the Sleeper drones from the moment they were discovered, quickly reverse engineering a subsystem for their Loki that could replicate the Sleeper's own offensive modules. The end result is a noticeable amplification of a stasis webifier's effective range.
45633.name: Loki Core - Immobility Drivers

A super-heavy pulse laser designed for medium range engagements. 

Requires either regular or advanced frequency crystal ammo types: Gamma, Infrared, Microwave, Multifrequency, Radio, Standard, Ultraviolet, Xray, Conflagration, Scorch.
3057.name: Mega Pulse Laser II

3540.description: This module uses nano-assemblers to repair damage done to the armor of the ship.
3540.name: Large Armor Repairer II

4250.description: By manipulating gravity fields, this module can pull cargo containers towards the ship.
4250.name: Small Tractor Beam II

10631.description: A tiny launcher that can carry a very limited supply of rockets. Not really intended as a primary weapon but rather as a cheap supplementary weapon system.

11269.description:
An enhanced version of the multispectrum armor coating. Uses advanced magnetic field generators to strengthen the effect. Grants a bonus to armor resistance against all types of damage. It is less effective than membranes tuned against a specific damage profile.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.
11269.name: Multispectrum Energized Membrane II

12084.description:
Massive boost to speed for a very short time. The thrust that boosts the ship, and the corresponding maximum velocity bonus, are limited by the mass of the ship that uses this module. The sheer amount of energy needed to power this system means that it must permanently reserve a fraction of the capacitor output just to maintain the integrity of its warp containment field, and when activated it substantially increases the ship's EM footprint.

Penalty: Max capacitor reduced.

Note: Battleship class module.
12084.name: 500MN Microwarpdrive II

12816.description:
The Conflagration is a supercharged X-Ray crystal created by Carthum Conglomerate for the Imperial Navy. Has much greater damage potential than the standard version, but needs considerably more capacitor, has reduced effective range and negatively affects the weapon's tracking speed. The delicate crystalline structures used in the manufacture of this advanced crystal degrade with use, eventually causing it to shatter.

50% reduced optimal range.
30% reduced tracking speed.
25% increased capacitor usage.

Note: This ammunition can only be used by large tech level II, faction and officer Pulse Lasers.
12816.name: Conflagration L

12820.description:
The Scorch is a UV crystal designed by Carthum Conglomerate. Utilizing AI microtrackers it gives a good boost to range but has fairly low damage potential, low tracking and is of limited use against heavily armored targets. The delicate crystalline structures used in the manufacture of this advanced crystal degrade with use, eventually causing it to shatter.

40% increased optimal range.
25% reduced tracking speed.

Note: This ammunition can only be used by large tech level II, faction and officer Pulse Lasers.
12820.name: Scorch L

20353.description:
Increases the maximum strength of the Armor.

Penalty: Adds to your ship's mass, making it less agile and maneuverable in addition to decreasing the factor of thrust gained from speed modules like Afterburners and MicroWarpdrives.
20353.name: 1600mm Steel Plates II

This modified version of the Scourge rocket packs a considerably stronger punch, but as a result is heavier and slower. This makes it very effective against larger targets, but markedly less effective against smaller and more agile targets.

28659.description: Geared toward versatility and prolonged deployment in hostile environments, Marauders represent the cutting edge in today’s warship technology. While being thick-skinned, hard-hitting monsters on their own, they are also able to use Bastion technology. Similar in effect to capital reconfiguration technology, when activated the Bastion module provides huge bonuses to firepower and the ability to withstand enormous amounts of punishment, at the cost of being stationary.
28659.name: Paladin

29001.description:
Originally used by the adolescent hacker group The 'Fendahlian Collective' to break past high tech security firmware, these script packs contain intricate code which modify the inherent behavior of certain modules by directly inserting commands into the firmware. The applications of such technology was not lost on the major players and the kids who invented it now head their own research divisions.

This script can be loaded into a tracking computer or tracking link module to increase the module's tracking speed bonus at the expense of its optimal range bonus.
29001.name: Tracking Speed Script

33011.description: A massive cargo container, used for inter-regional freight; most commonly used in freighter cargo bays.
33011.name: Small Freight Container

33400.description:
An electronic interface designed to augment and enhance a marauder's siege abilities. Through a series of electromagnetic polarity field shifts, the bastion module diverts energy from the ship's propulsion and warp systems to lend additional power to its defensive and offensive capabilities.

This results in a greatly increased rate of defensive self-sustenance and a boost to the ship's overall damage resistances. It also extends the reach of all the vessel's weapon systems and their rate of fire, allowing it to engage targets at farther ranges. 

As a side effect of the ionic field created by the bastion module, beneficial remote repair and capacitor transfer effects are ineffective against the fitted ship while the module is active.

In addition, the lack of power to mobility subsystems means that neither standard propulsion nor warp travel are available to the ship, nor is it allowed to dock or jump until out of bastion mode.

Note: Only one bastion module can be fitted to a marauder-class ship. The increased shield boosting and armor repairing gained from the bastion module is subject to a stacking penalty when used with other modules that affect the same attribute on the ship.

Rapid Heavy Missile Launchers are not affected by bastion modules.
33400.name: Bastion Module I

41057.description:
Stasis Grapplers reduce the maximum speed of a target ship by employing micro energy streams which effectively entangle the target temporarily, thereby slowing it down.
This slowing effect is strongest at very close ranges, and diminishes as range increases.
Heavy Stasis Grapplers require a very stable base platform, and therefore may only be fitted to Battleships and Capital Ships.
41057.name: Heavy Stasis Grappler II

97208.description: This keypass grants single-use access to private shortcut acceleration gate within Tetrimon Base and Tetrimon Frontline Base complexes.
97208.name: Tetrimon Base Shortcut Keypass

3090.description:
This large battleship-sized weapon packs quite a punch. Railguns use magnetic rails to fire solid chunks of matter at hypersonic speed. The accurate range of railguns is very good, but due to technical limitations it cannot use onboard guidance. This results in a fairly rapid drop in accuracy at extreme ranges. 

Requires either regular or advanced hybrid charge types: Antimatter, Iridium, Iron, Lead, Plutonium, Thorium, Tungsten, Uranium, Javelin, Spike.
3090.name: 425mm Railgun II

4383.description: The Micro Jump Drive is a module that spools up, then jumps the ship forward 100km in the direction it is facing. Upon arrival, the ship maintains its direction and velocity. Warp scramblers can be used to disrupt the module. Spool up time is reduced by the skill Micro Jump Drive Operation. The Micro Jump Drive was developed by Duvolle Laboratories Advanced Manifold Theory Unit. The drive was conceived by the late Avagher Xarasier, the genius behind several ground-breaking innovations of that era.
4383.name: Large Micro Jump Drive

10631.description: A tiny launcher that can carry a very limited supply of rockets. Not really intended as a primary weapon but rather as a cheap supplementary weapon system.

A salvage drone respects wreck ownership and will focus on its operator's wrecks unless explicitly ordered otherwise. Whether or not its operator chooses to display that same respect is another question entirely.
32787.name: Salvage Drone I

33475.description:
The mobile tractoring unit takes some of the work out of looting the scorched ruins left by capsuleers, be it pulverized asteroids, wrecked ships, or obliterated inhabitation modules of various kinds. Once it has been deployed and completed its automatic activation process, it will lock on to any containers or wrecks within range, reel them in one by one, and empty their contents into its own cargo bay. All the capsuleer needs to do is keep up the pace of destruction.

125km effective range.
10 second activation time.

May not be deployed within 5km of another Mobile Tractor Unit, within 50km of Stargates, Stations or Upwell Structures, or within 40km of a Starbase.
Automatically decays if abandoned for two days.
33475.name: Mobile Tractor Unit

35661.description:

The sheer amount of energy needed to power this system means that it must permanently reserve a fraction of the capacitor output just to maintain the integrity of its warp containment field, and when activated it substantially increases the ship's EM footprint.

Penalty: Max capacitor reduced.

Note: Battleship class module.
35661.name: 500MN Y-T8 Compact Microwarpdrive

41219.description: Increases capacitor storage. Provides defense against Energy Leech and Energy Neutralizer effects.

15683.name: Republic Fleet Ballistic Control System

15907.description:
Focuses and amplifies the efficiency of shield boosting modules. 

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.
15907.name: Republic Fleet Shield Boost Amplifier

19197.description: Expends energy to provide a quick boost in shield strength.
19197.name: Gist A-Type X-Large Shield Booster

19739.description: A battleship mounted launcher used for long range standoffs with other battleships, but less suitable for bombardment of deployed structures. Contains a huge missile capacity, but has a slow firing rate and trouble targeting small, fast ships.
19739.name: Cruise Missile Launcher II

20307.description: A kinetic warhead designed for use with heavy assault launchers. Heavy assault missiles can be fired at a greater rate than heavy missiles, at the expense of effective range.
20307.name: Scourge Heavy Assault Missile

24471.description:
A small rocket with a piercing warhead.

This modified version of the Scourge rocket packs a considerably stronger punch, but as a result is heavier and slower. This makes it very effective against larger targets, but markedly less effective against smaller and more agile targets.
24471.name: Scourge Rage Rocket

24477.description:
A small rocket with a piercing warhead.

A modified version of the Scourge rocket. It can reach higher velocity than the Scourge rocket at the expense of warhead size.
24477.name: Scourge Javelin Rocket

24495.description:
From its humble beginnings in tiny Minmatar design labs, the Scourge light missile has quickly established itself throughout the star cluster as a premier missile for light launchers.

A modified version of the Scourge light missile. Does more damage than its predecessor but the volatile nature of the warhead, and its powerful containment system, reduce both flight time and precision.
24495.name: Scourge Fury Light Missile

24501.description:
From its humble beginnings in tiny Minmatar design labs, the Scourge light missile has quickly established itself throughout the star cluster as a premier missile for light launchers.

A modified version of the Scourge light missile. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.
24501.name: Scourge Precision Light Missile

24513.description:
The Scourge heavy missile is an old relic from the Caldari-Gallente War that is still in widespread use because of its low price and versatility.

A modified version of the Scourge heavy missile. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.
24513.name: Scourge Precision Heavy Missile

24525.description:
An ultra-heavy plasma missile. While it is a slow projectile, its sheer damage potential is simply staggering.

A modified version of the Inferno Torpedo. It can reach higher velocity than the Inferno Torpedo at the expense of warhead size.
24525.name: Inferno Javelin Torpedo

24533.description:
The first Minmatar-made large missile. Constructed of reactionary alloys, the Scourge cruise missile is built to get to the target. Guidance and propulsion systems are of Gallente origin and were initially used in drones, making this a nimble projectile despite its heavy payload.

A modified version of the Scourge cruise. Does more damage than its predecessor but the volatile nature of the warhead, and its powerful containment system, reduce both flight time and precision.
24533.name: Scourge Fury Cruise Missile

24541.description:
The first Minmatar-made large missile. Constructed of reactionary alloys, the Scourge cruise missile is built to get to the target. Guidance and propulsion systems are of Gallente origin and were initially used in drones, making this a nimble projectile despite its heavy payload.

A modified version of the Scourge cruise. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.
24541.name: Scourge Precision Cruise Missile

25715.description: A launcher intended for use on cruiser-class spacecraft. While assault launchers do not possess the sheer damage-dealing capability of regular heavy missile launchers, their blend of speed and attack power lends them application across a good range of tactical situations.
25715.name: Heavy Assault Missile Launcher II

26374.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's capacitor recharge rate.
26374.name: Large Capacitor Control Circuit II

28710.description: Geared toward versatility and prolonged deployment in hostile environments, Marauders represent the cutting edge in today’s warship technology. While being thick-skinned, hard-hitting monsters on their own, they are also able to use Bastion technology. Similar in effect to capital reconfiguration technology, when activated the Bastion module provides huge bonuses to firepower and the ability to withstand enormous amounts of punishment, at the cost of being stationary.
28710.name: Golem

31944.description:
A targeting subsystem that projects an electronic "Tag" on the target thus making it easier to target and hit. 

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.
31944.name: Republic Fleet Target Painter

33400.description:
An electronic interface designed to augment and enhance a marauder's siege abilities. Through a series of electromagnetic polarity field shifts, the bastion module diverts energy from the ship's propulsion and warp systems to lend additional power to its defensive and offensive capabilities.

This results in a greatly increased rate of defensive self-sustenance and a boost to the ship's overall damage resistances. It also extends the reach of all the vessel's weapon systems and their rate of fire, allowing it to engage targets at farther ranges. 

As a side effect of the ionic field created by the bastion module, beneficial remote repair and capacitor transfer effects are ineffective against the fitted ship while the module is active.

In addition, the lack of power to mobility subsystems means that neither standard propulsion nor warp travel are available to the ship, nor is it allowed to dock or jump until out of bastion mode.

Note: Only one bastion module can be fitted to a marauder-class ship. The increased shield boosting and armor repairing gained from the bastion module is subject to a stacking penalty when used with other modules that affect the same attribute on the ship.

Rapid Heavy Missile Launchers are not affected by bastion modules.
33400.name: Bastion Module I

33700.description:
The mobile tractoring unit takes some of the work out of looting the scorched ruins left by capsuleers, be it pulverized asteroids, wrecked ships, or obliterated inhabitation modules of various kinds. Once it has been deployed and completed its automatic activation process, it will lock on to any containers or wrecks within range, reel them in one by one, and empty their contents into its own cargo bay. All the capsuleer needs to do is keep up the pace of destruction.

125km effective range.
10 second activation time.

May not be deployed within 5km of another Mobile Tractor Unit, within 50km of Stargates, Stations or Upwell Structures, or within 40km of a Starbase.
Automatically decays if abandoned for two days.
33700.name: 'Packrat' Mobile Tractor Unit

41218.description: Increases capacitor storage. Provides defense against Energy Leech and Energy Neutralizer effects.
41218.name: Republic Fleet Large Cap Battery

expected.note: pyfa (all-V skills, Bastion active, 2026-10-08): DPS 1654 (Weapon 1654, Drone 0), EHP 82.5k (shield 42.6k/armor 19.4k/hull 20.5k). Tool EHP is an EXACT match on every field (shield 42577/armor 19385/hull 20522/total 82485) -- this fit was never affected by either the Compensation-skill bug (no qualifying hardener group fitted) or the resist-defensiveGroups bug. DPS: after applying the flat -50% Bastion RoF fix confirmed exactly on 3 independent turret-based Marauders (Vargur/Paladin/Kronos, all landing on an EXACT weapon-DPS match), this torpedo-based Marauder instead lands at weapon-only 1574 vs pyfa's 1654 -- 4.8% low, NOT an exact match. OPEN QUESTION (bug-class #15b): live ESI confirms Golem carries effect 4635 'eliteBonusMaraudersCruiseAndTorpedoDamageRole1' (a Marauder-class intrinsic Cruise/Torpedo damage role bonus, modifying attribute 1268=100 identically on Paladin/Kronos/Golem) that has NO entry in this tool's SHIP_ROLE_BONUS table for ANY Marauder hull -- it is possible this bonus is genuinely active for missile-based Marauders but happens to be a no-op (0% in practice) for the turret-based ones tested so far, which would explain why Vargur/Paladin/Kronos matched exactly without it while Golem doesn't. NOT yet confirmed from primary sources what attribute 1268 actually resolves to in-game, so this has deliberately NOT been implemented as a guess -- left as a flagged, range-tolerant DPS check (95%-110% of the tool's current figure) until a torpedo/cruise-missile-specific mechanism can be pinned down with the same rigor as the turret RoF fix. CORRECTED 2026-10-12 (KNOWN OPEN ITEM #2/#5 fix): shieldRepSustainedDps 171->232. This fit carries a Republic Fleet Shield Boost Amplifier (attr548=+36%, confirmed live), which was not read anywhere before this fix -- 171 was the Gist A-Type X-Large Shield Booster bare rate (682 HP / 4s = 170.5), 232 = 170.5 x 1.36, hand-verified against the module's own real dogma attributes. RESOLVED 2026-10-13 (closes bug-list item 'Golem torpedo Bastion RoF ratio', #15b): the gap was never torpedoes or Bastion. pyfa's 1654 'Weapon' figure INCLUDES this fit's 2x Shadow Serpentis Large Plasma Smartbomb; the 4.8% figure came from comparing torpedo-only 1574 against pyfa's total. The real residual was the unmodeled Energy Pulse Weapons skill (-5%/lvl smartbomb duration): smartbombs 2 x 300 / 7.5s = 80 DPS (tool had 60 at a raw 10s cycle) -> 1574 + 80 = 1654, an EXACT pyfa match. Range tightened to the exact value. UPDATE 2026-10-13 (v2026.10.13.13, targeting batch): pins scanResolution=105 (was 175): its Improved Cloaking Device II carries pyfa cloakingScanResolutionMultiplier (effect 854, an 'offline' effect -- applies whenever fitted) attr565 = 0.6, penaltyGroup PostMul: 175 x 0.6 = 105. UPDATE 2026-10-13 (v2026.10.13.15, repairs batch): Marauders shield bonus (effect 4974, +37.5%) and Bastion: Bastion's +60% shares one stacking-penalized group with the fitted Shield Boost Amplifier (+36%): pen[1.6, 1.36] = 2.1005 (was 1.36 alone), duration x0.8. 232 x2.1005/1.36 x1.375 / 0.8 = 616. UPDATE 2026-10-13 (v2026.10.13.17, weapon range batch): Golem shipBonusCB3 torpedo velocity (effect 4637) + Bastion missileVelocityBonus +25%. INDEPENDENT derivation: 82,012.5 m. UPDATE 2026-10-13 (v2026.10.13.19, recorder audit): Bastion's +100% sensor strength (pyfa Effect6658, attrs 1027-1030, penalized with Sensor Boosters/Signal Amps) was excluded; now applied like Bastion's other always-assumed effects: 27.6 x2 = 55.2. UPDATE 2026-10-14 (v2026.10.14.7, missile range from pyfa): Missile range from tools/independent_checks/check_missile_range.py: pyfa's own Module.missileMaxRangeData (lifted unmodified from eos/saveddata/module.py) on attributes from tools/pyfa_fit_oracle.py; displayed range = Module.maxRange's weighted average, split = pyfa's range-column tooltip. rangeTravelDistanceM 82013 -> 81983; 17% chance of 75658 m, 83% of 83252 m.

NOT a pyfa-client cross-check, so pinned as a floor/structural guard, not an exact golden value (same policy as the Manticore fit from bug-class #18).

Grants a bonus to resistance for shield, armor and hull.

Only one Damage Control can be fit at a given time.
2048.name: Damage Control II

2404.description: Favored by many for its average capacity and firing rate. Useful in both fast attack raids and longer battles.
2404.name: Light Missile Launcher II

2410.description: Designed for long engagements between medium sized ships. Slow firing rate, but makes up for it with a large missile capacity.
2410.name: Heavy Missile Launcher II

2420.description: A massive launcher designed for extended bombardments of hard targets like battleships and stations. Contains a huge missile capacity, but has a slow firing rate and trouble targeting small, fast ships.
2420.name: Torpedo Launcher II

2605.description:
Replaces some of the heavier structure components with lighter, but more fragile material. Increases ship's velocity and improves maneuverability at the expense of hull strength.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.
2605.name: Nanofiber Internal Structure II

2629.description:
The Scourge heavy missile is an old relic from the Caldari-Gallente War that is still in widespread use because of its low price and versatility.

A modified version of the Scourge heavy missile. Does more damage than its predecessor but the volatile nature of the warhead, and its powerful containment system, reduce both flight time and precision.
2629.name: Scourge Fury Heavy Missile

3244.description: Disrupts the target ship's navigation computer which prevents it from warping.
3244.name: Warp Disruptor II

3568.description: Provides a quick injection of power into the capacitor.
3568.name: Small Capacitor Booster II

10631.description: A tiny launcher that can carry a very limited supply of rockets. Not really intended as a primary weapon but rather as a cheap supplementary weapon system.
10631.name: Rocket Launcher II

11269.description:
An enhanced version of the multispectrum armor coating. Uses advanced magnetic field generators to strengthen the effect. Grants a bonus to armor resistance against all types of damage. It is less effective than membranes tuned against a specific damage profile.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.
11269.name: Multispectrum Energized Membrane II

12058.description:
Gives a boost to the maximum velocity of the ship when activated. The thrust that boosts the ship, and the corresponding maximum velocity bonus, are limited by the mass of the ship that uses this module.

Note: Usually fit on Cruisers and Battlecruisers.
12058.name: 10MN Afterburner II

16469.description: Neutralizes a portion of the energy in the target ship's capacitor.
16469.name: Medium Infectious Scoped Energy Neutralizer

25715.name: Heavy Assault Missile Launcher II

26892.description:
A small deployable self powered unit that creates a disruption field around its anchored position. Ships within its area of effect will be unable to activate their warp drive, and any ships arriving within 500km of its vicinity on a vector that would theoretically cross its field, will find themselves pulled into its uncaring grasp.

This disruptor can operate in space continuously for seven days, after which it will automatically decay.
26892.name: Mobile Small Warp Disruptor II

28668.description:
A thick, heavy liquid, typically stored in tanks or container systems intended for liquids. It is composed of billions of nanites that can be programmed to repair damaged ship modules on the fly. The paste is simply applied to the damaged area, and the nanites meld into an exact copy of the damaged area, thus effecting repairs upon the module. This is a one-time process, as the nanites use themselves up along with the trace elements mixed into their carrier fluid.

The Repair Paste is generally only used for emergency on-site repairs. It is then recommended to have the damaged components looked at by a certified technician at first opportunity.
28668.name: Nanite Repair Paste

28674.description: This booster throws a pilot into temporary dementia, making every target feel like a monstrous threat that must be destroyed at all cost. The pilot manages to force their turrets into better tracking, though it may take a while before they stop wanting to kill everything in sight.
28674.name: Synth Drop Booster

28676.description: This booster hardens a pilot's resistance to attacks, letting them withstand their impact to a greater extent. The discomfort of having their armor reduced piecemeal remains unaltered, but the pilot is filled with such a surge of rage that they bully through it like a living tank.
28676.name: Synth Exile Booster

31155.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's agility at the expense of armor amount. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Astronautics Rigging skill.
31155.name: Medium Low Friction Nozzle Joints I

31185.description: This ship modification is designed to increase ship's velocity and maneuverability at the expense of armor amount. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Astronautics Rigging skill.
31185.name: Medium Polycarbon Engine Housing II

31366.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's powergrid capacity.
31366.name: Medium Ancillary Current Router II

32006.description: Provides a quick injection of power into your capacitor. Good for tight situations!
32006.name: Navy Cap Booster 400

33101.description:
This module uses nano-assemblers to repair damage done to the armor of the ship. The module can optionally use Nanite Repair Paste to increase repair effectiveness. Deactivating the module while it has no Nanite Repair Paste loaded starts reloading, if there is Nanite Repair Paste available in cargo hold. 

Note: Can use Nanite Repair Paste as fuel. Reloading time is 60 seconds. Prototype Inferno Module.
33101.name: Medium Ancillary Armor Repairer

33474.description:
The mobile depot provides capsuleers with their very own base in space. It won't offer protection, but once deployed and activated it can allow the capsuleer to store their most valuable belongings and to refit their ship while exploring far and wide across New Eden.

Once launched into space a mobile depot takes one minute to activate, during which time it is extremely vulnerable to attack. If a fully activated mobile depot with high shields comes under attack, it will enter a 48 hour reinforcement period once damaged below 25% shield hitpoints. During this reinforcement period the depot does not provide refitting services and cannot receive new cargo, however existing cargo can be removed and the depot can still be scooped into a ship by its owner.

May not be deployed within 6km of another Mobile Depot, 50km of Stargates, Stations or Upwell Structures, 40km of a Starbase, or within 75km of a Moon Mining Beacon.

Automatically decays if abandoned for thirty days.
33474.name: Mobile Depot

35659.description:
Massive boost to speed for a very short time. The thrust that boosts the ship, and the corresponding maximum velocity bonus, are limited by the mass of the ship that uses this module. The sheer amount of energy needed to power this system means that it must permanently reserve a fraction of the capacitor output just to maintain the integrity of its warp containment field, and when activated it substantially increases the ship's EM footprint.

Penalty: Max capacitor reduced.

Note: Usually fit on Cruisers and Battlecruisers.
35659.name: 50MN Y-T8 Compact Microwarpdrive

47270.description: A powerful strike craft that is the Collective's conception of a cruiser, the Vedmak has proven adaptable to capsuleer technology along with the other Triglavian ship designs recovered from Abyssal Deadspace. The Vedmak is capable of mounting Heavy Entropic Disintegrators and an array of support weapons such as energy neutralizers and pulse weapons. The ship also makes use of drones and has a long-range remote repair capability. Vedmak Subclade of Svarog Clade relinquished the adaptation schema of reverse-time accepted 81 tactical troika classification into the cladeflow of Triglav after cladistic mortification by Dazhbog Subclade. Strategic troika have advancing-time pressure for adaptation into tactical subroles. – partial translation of data included in recovered design schematics of the Vedmak
47270.name: Vedmak

47886.description:
An Entropic Disintegrator uses charges of exotic plasma to provide the particle feedstock for the weapon's beam, with different forms of exotic matter modulating the beam's characteristics.

Tetryon Exotic Plasma charges yield a beam with very high thermal damage potential but a significantly reduced range.
47886.name: Tetryon Exotic Plasma M

47911.description:
Entropic Disintegrators generate a considerable amount of radiation when firing and this must be contained in order to avoid a dangerous build up. Bringing online additional Entropic Radiation Sinks allows the weapons to be fired at higher levels of energy and more rapidly, considerably increasing their damage potential.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.
47911.name: Entropic Radiation Sink II

47918.description:
This medium-sized Entropic Disintegrator is normally seen in use on Triglavian cruisers or battlecruisers, which are able to handle the increased radiation and serious gravitational tidal forces the weapon generates as a side-effect of its operation.

Entropic Disintegrators draw on the tremendous power of the Triglavian singularity-based energy systems to convert exotic matter into a particle stream directed with locally generated entropic force. While powerful, the range of the weapon is limited by the attenuation of entropic forces, which dissipate critically beyond the optimal range. As a result this weapon has no falloff range.

The particle stream generates thermal and explosive reactions on impact, and the entropic forces resolve into a localized gravitational conduit that steadily increases the acceleration on the exotic particles. In effect, the weapon's damage potential increases to a maximum level as long as the particle stream is kept on the same target.

Requires either standard or advanced exotic plasma charge ammo types: Baryon, Meson, Tetryon, Mystic, and Occult.
47918.name: Heavy Entropic Disintegrator II

47929.description:
An Entropic Disintegrator uses charges of exotic plasma to provide the particle feedstock for the weapon's beam, with different forms of exotic matter modulating the beam's characteristics.

Meson Exotic Plasma charges yield a beam with a very long range but reduced thermal and explosive damage potential.
47929.name: Meson Exotic Plasma M

47930.description:
An Entropic Disintegrator uses charges of exotic plasma to provide the particle feedstock for the weapon's beam, with different forms of exotic matter modulating the beam's characteristics.

An experimental exotic plasma charge developed using advanced technology in conjunction with Precursor weapons tech, the Occult charge achieves heavy thermal and explosive damage potential. 

This high damage comes at the expense of range and significant loss in the stability of the disintegrator beam. This instability reduces the tracking of weapons using Occult Exotic Plasma charges.
47930.name: Occult M

47931.description:
An Entropic Disintegrator uses charges of exotic plasma to provide the particle feedstock for the weapon's beam, with different forms of exotic matter modulating the beam's characteristics.

An experimental exotic plasma charge developed using advanced technology in conjunction with Precursor weapons tech, the Mystic charge achieves high thermal damage potential at longer ranges than would normally be possible. 

However, explosive damage remains low and there is a serious loss in the stability of the disintegrator beam. This instability reduces the tracking of weapons using Mystic Exotic Plasma charges.
47931.name: Mystic M

53984.description:
Following the success of the Frostline Laboratories experimental trials with Triglavian filament technology, the Outer Ring Excavations group authorized the commencement of "Project Needlejack". Working in conjunction with Frostline, ORE Technologies was able to refine the technology into a cost-effective product even though the means of precisely establishing a conduit destination continued to elude its scientists.

The prototype designs include a filament device that opens a conduit able to transport 5 ships to a pseudorandom destination weighted by "signal profiles" discernible in the quantum fluctuations of space-time. ORE's development team configured their prototype to target quantum signal profiles suggesting higher levels of activity in nullsec space systems.

The Signal-5 'Needlejack' Filament device has been reported as falling into the hands of a number of outlaw and underworld groups across New Eden, and is likely to be found in certain of their secure data sites.
53984.name: Signal-5 'Needlejack' Filament

56070.description:
The Cladistic-5 'Krai Perun' Filament permits up to 5 ships to travel from Known Space to a system in Triglavian space controlled by the Perun Clade.

Triglavian mastery of space-time conduit technology allows them relatively fine control over the generation and targeting of FTL conduits. The filament devices used by Triglavian forces aligned to Perun Clade are connected to the artificial constellation of Krai Perun. Even those unfamiliar with how to precisely target them will find the conduits they generate will transport them to Perun-controlled space.
56070.name: Cladistic-5 'Krai Perun' Filament

56072.description:
The Cladistic-5 'Krai Veles' Filament permits up to 5 ships to travel from Known Space to a system in Triglavian space controlled by the Veles Clade.

Triglavian mastery of space-time conduit technology allows them relatively fine control over the generation and targeting of FTL conduits. The filament devices used by Triglavian forces aligned to Veles Clade are connected to the artificial constellation of Krai Veles. Even those unfamiliar with how to precisely target them will find the conduits they generate will transport them to Veles-controlled space.
56072.name: Cladistic-5 'Krai Veles' Filament

expected.note: Guards against bug-class #20 regressing (weapon/ammo going back to totally unrecognized -> confirmedWeaponCount 0, unmatchedWeaponCount 1, dpsFixed dropping to droneDps-only ~126). confirmedWeaponCount/unmatchedWeaponCount pinned exact (structural, not magnitude-sensitive). dpsFixed_min set conservatively below the hand-verified ~472 so future legitimate tuning (e.g. adding a Vedmak SHIP_ROLE_BONUS entry, which would only increase this) does not spuriously fail.
