203.description: The first Minmatar-made large missile. Constructed of reactionary alloys, the Scourge cruise missile is built to get to the target. Guidance and propulsion systems are of Gallente origin and were initially used in drones, making this a nimble projectile despite its heavy payload.
203.name: Scourge Cruise Missile

209.description: The Scourge heavy missile is an old relic from the Caldari-Gallente War that is still in widespread use because of its low price and versatility.
209.name: Scourge Heavy Missile

210.description: From its humble beginnings in tiny Minmatar design labs, the Scourge light missile has quickly established itself throughout the star cluster as a premier missile for light launchers.
210.name: Scourge Light Missile

257.description:
Modulates the beam of a laser weapon into the infrared frequencies. Slightly improved range.

20% increased optimal range.
35% reduced capacitor need.
257.name: Infrared L

260.description:
Modulates the beam of a laser weapon into the xray frequencies. Reduced range. Increased damage.

25% reduced optimal range.
25% reduced capacitor need.
260.name: Xray L

266.description: A small rocket with a piercing warhead.
266.name: Scourge Rocket

267.description: An ultra-heavy piercing missile. While it is a slow projectile, its sheer damage potential is simply staggering.
267.name: Scourge Torpedo

448.description: Disrupts the target ship's navigation computer, disabling warping, jumping, microwarpdrives and micro jump drives.
448.name: Warp Scrambler II

1541.description: Monitors and optimizes the power grid. Gives a slight boost to power core output and a minor increase in shield and capacitor recharge rate.
1541.name: Power Diagnostic System II

2048.description:
Utilizes a combination of containment field emitters and redundancy systems to mitigate the impact of critical system damage. 

Grants a bonus to resistance for shield, armor and hull.

Only one Damage Control can be fit at a given time.
2048.name: Damage Control II

2117.description:
Emits random electronic bursts which have a chance of momentarily disrupting target locks on ships within range.

This module can be equipped to Battleship, Marauder, Black Ops, Command Ship, Hauler, Blockade Runner, and Deep Space Transport ships.

Note: Only one module of this type can be activated at the same time. Additionally, fitting a Burst Jammer module will disable interdiction nullification.
2117.name: Burst Jammer II

2281.description:
Boosts shield resistance against all damage types.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module, or similar modules that affect the same resistance type, will result in a penalty to the boost you get on that type of resistance.
2281.name: Multispectrum Shield Hardener II

2299.description:
Boosts shield resistance against kinetic damage.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module, or similar modules that affect the same resistance type, will result in a penalty to the boost you get on that type of resistance
2299.name: Kinetic Shield Hardener II

2404.description: Favored by many for its average capacity and firing rate. Useful in both fast attack raids and longer battles.
2404.name: Light Missile Launcher II

2410.description: Designed for long engagements between medium sized ships. Slow firing rate, but makes up for it with a large missile capacity.
2410.name: Heavy Missile Launcher II

2420.description: A massive launcher designed for extended bombardments of hard targets like battleships and stations. Contains a huge missile capacity, but has a slow firing rate and trouble targeting small, fast ships.
2420.name: Torpedo Launcher II

2629.description:
The Scourge heavy missile is an old relic from the Caldari-Gallente War that is still in widespread use because of its low price and versatility.

A modified version of the Scourge heavy missile. Does more damage than its predecessor but the volatile nature of the warhead, and its powerful containment system, reduce both flight time and precision.
2629.name: Scourge Fury Heavy Missile

2679.description:
A kinetic warhead designed for use with heavy assault launchers. Heavy assault missiles can be fired at a greater rate than heavy missiles, at the expense of effective range.

This modified version of the Scourge Heavy Assault Missile packs a considerably stronger punch, but as a result is heavier and slower. This makes it very effective against larger targets, but markedly less effective against smaller and more agile targets.
2679.name: Scourge Rage Heavy Assault Missile

3578.description: Provides a quick injection of power into the capacitor.
3578.name: Heavy Capacitor Booster II

3841.description: Increases the maximum strength of the shield.
3841.name: Large Shield Extender II

3979.description: Radiates an omnidirectional pulse from the ship that causes explosive damage to surrounding vessels.
3979.name: Large Proton Smartbomb II

4258.description: Launcher for Core Scanner Probes, which are used to scan down Cosmic Signatures in space. Note: Only one probe launcher can be fitted per ship. 5% bonus to strength of scan probes.
4258.name: Core Probe Launcher II

4383.description: The Micro Jump Drive is a module that spools up, then jumps the ship forward 100km in the direction it is facing. Upon arrival, the ship maintains its direction and velocity. Warp scramblers can be used to disrupt the module. Spool up time is reduced by the skill Micro Jump Drive Operation. The Micro Jump Drive was developed by Duvolle Laboratories Advanced Manifold Theory Unit. The drive was conceived by the late Avagher Xarasier, the genius behind several ground-breaking innovations of that era.
4383.name: Large Micro Jump Drive

5955.description:
Gives a boost to the maximum velocity of the ship when activated. The thrust that boosts the ship, and the corresponding maximum velocity bonus, are limited by the mass of the ship that uses this module.

Note: Usually fit on Battleships.
5955.name: 100MN Monopropellant Enduring Afterburner

5975.description:
Massive boost to speed for a very short time. The thrust that boosts the ship, and the corresponding maximum velocity bonus, are limited by the mass of the ship that uses this module. The sheer amount of energy needed to power this system means that it must permanently reserve a fraction of the capacitor output just to maintain the integrity of its warp containment field, and when activated it substantially increases the ship's EM footprint.

Penalty: Max capacitor reduced.

Note: Usually fit on Cruisers and Battlecruisers.
5975.name: 50MN Cold-Gas Enduring Microwarpdrive

10631.description: A tiny launcher that can carry a very limited supply of rockets. Not really intended as a primary weapon but rather as a cheap supplementary weapon system.
10631.name: Rocket Launcher II

10850.description: Expends energy to provide a quick boost in shield strength.
10850.name: Medium Shield Booster II

11993.description:
No cruiser currently in existence can match the superiority of the Cerberus's onboard missile system. With a well-trained pilot jacked in, this fanged horror is capable of unleashing a hail of missiles to send even the most seasoned armor tankers running for cover. 

Moving away from their traditionally balanced all-round designs, Lai Dai have created a very specialized - and dangerous - missile boat in the Cerberus. Many have speculated that due to recent friction between Caldari megacorporations, LD may be looking to beef up their own police force with these missile-spewing monstrosities.
11993.name: Cerberus

12058.description:
Gives a boost to the maximum velocity of the ship when activated. The thrust that boosts the ship, and the corresponding maximum velocity bonus, are limited by the mass of the ship that uses this module.

Note: Usually fit on Cruisers and Battlecruisers.
12058.name: 10MN Afterburner II

14047.description:
Focuses and amplifies the efficiency of shield boosting modules. 

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.
14047.name: Dread Guristas Shield Boost Amplifier

15593.description: Identification tags such as these may prove valuable if handed to the proper organization.
15593.name: Federation Navy Fleet Major Insignia I

15601.description: Identification tags such as these may prove valuable if handed to the proper organization.
15601.name: Caldari Navy Captain Insignia III

15660.description: Identification tags such as these may prove valuable if handed to the proper organization.
15660.name: Republic Fleet Private Insignia III

15673.description: Identification tags such as these may prove valuable if handed to the proper organization.
15673.name: Federation Navy Fleet Colonel Insignia II

15992.description: Identification tags such as these may prove valuable if handed to the proper organization.
15992.name: Imperial Navy Sergeant Insignia II

15994.description: Identification tags such as these may prove valuable if handed to the proper organization.
15994.name: Federation Navy Sergeant Insignia II

19231.description:
Boosts the EM resistance of the shield.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.
19231.name: Pithum A-Type EM Shield Amplifier

19406.description:
Obtaining a Deadspace Overseer's personal effects is proof that you have finished clearing all major obstacles in a deadspace pocket and decimated the leading figure.

Anyone that procures an OPE (from the pirates themselves, their bases or from guarded containers) can sell them to CONCORD or DED for a reasonable amount of cash.

CONCORD has rated Deadspace Overseers by the threat they pose to society and divided them into tiers that dictate how much a seller gets for their effects.
19406.name: 7th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects

19739.description: A battleship mounted launcher used for long range standoffs with other battleships, but less suitable for bombardment of deployed structures. Contains a huge missile capacity, but has a slow firing rate and trouble targeting small, fast ships.
19739.name: Cruise Missile Launcher II

20307.description: A kinetic warhead designed for use with heavy assault launchers. Heavy assault missiles can be fired at a greater rate than heavy missiles, at the expense of effective range.
20307.name: Scourge Heavy Assault Missile

22291.description:
A computer system designed for monitoring and guiding missiles in flight, thus allowing for superior effectiveness and lethality. 

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.
22291.name: Ballistic Control System II

22470.description: Command ships are engineered specifically to wreak havoc on a battlefield of many. Sporting advanced command module interfaces, these vessels are more than capable of turning the tide in large engagements. Command ships represent the ultimate in Command Burst efficiency; the boosts they give their comrades in combat make them indispensable assets to any well-rounded fleet.
22470.name: Nighthawk

23111.description:
Modulates the beam of a laser weapon into the ultraviolet frequencies. Slightly reduced range. Slightly increased thermal damage.

The delicate crystalline structures used in the manufacture of this advanced crystal degrade with use, eventually causing it to shatter.

12.5% reduced optimal range.
35% reduced capacitor need.
23111.name: Imperial Navy Ultraviolet L

24471.description:
A small rocket with a piercing warhead.

This modified version of the Scourge rocket packs a considerably stronger punch, but as a result is heavier and slower. This makes it very effective against larger targets, but markedly less effective against smaller and more agile targets.
24471.name: Scourge Rage Rocket

24477.description:
A small rocket with a piercing warhead.

A modified version of the Scourge rocket. It can reach higher velocity than the Scourge rocket at the expense of warhead size.
24477.name: Scourge Javelin Rocket

24495.description:
From its humble beginnings in tiny Minmatar design labs, the Scourge light missile has quickly established itself throughout the star cluster as a premier missile for light launchers.

A modified version of the Scourge light missile. Does more damage than its predecessor but the volatile nature of the warhead, and its powerful containment system, reduce both flight time and precision.
24495.name: Scourge Fury Light Missile

24501.description:
From its humble beginnings in tiny Minmatar design labs, the Scourge light missile has quickly established itself throughout the star cluster as a premier missile for light launchers.

A modified version of the Scourge light missile. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.
24501.name: Scourge Precision Light Missile

24513.description:
The Scourge heavy missile is an old relic from the Caldari-Gallente War that is still in widespread use because of its low price and versatility.

A modified version of the Scourge heavy missile. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.
24513.name: Scourge Precision Heavy Missile

24533.description:
The first Minmatar-made large missile. Constructed of reactionary alloys, the Scourge cruise missile is built to get to the target. Guidance and propulsion systems are of Gallente origin and were initially used in drones, making this a nimble projectile despite its heavy payload.

A modified version of the Scourge cruise. Does more damage than its predecessor but the volatile nature of the warhead, and its powerful containment system, reduce both flight time and precision.
24533.name: Scourge Fury Cruise Missile

24541.description:
The first Minmatar-made large missile. Constructed of reactionary alloys, the Scourge cruise missile is built to get to the target. Guidance and propulsion systems are of Gallente origin and were initially used in drones, making this a nimble projectile despite its heavy payload.

A modified version of the Scourge cruise. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.
24541.name: Scourge Precision Cruise Missile

24688.description: Having long suffered the lack of an adequate hybrid platform, the Caldari State's capsule pilots found themselves rejoicing as the Rokh's design specs were released. A fleet vessel if ever there was one, this far-reaching and durable beast is expected to see a great deal of service on battlefields near and far.
24688.name: Rokh

25715.description: A launcher intended for use on cruiser-class spacecraft. While assault launchers do not possess the sheer damage-dealing capability of regular heavy missile launchers, their blend of speed and attack power lends them application across a good range of tactical situations.
25715.name: Heavy Assault Missile Launcher II

26088.description: This ship modification is designed to increase shield capacity at the expense of increased signature radius. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Shield Rigging skill.
26088.name: Large Core Defense Field Extender I

26436.description: This ship modification is designed to increase the EM resistance of ship shields at the expense of increased signature radius. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Shield Rigging skill.
26436.name: Large EM Shield Reinforcer II

30013.description: A scanner probe used for scanning down Cosmic Signatures in space. Can be launched from Core Probe Launchers and Expanded Probe Launchers.
30013.name: Core Scanner Probe I

31646.description: This ship modification is designed to decrease the signature radius factor for missile explosions at the expense of increased CPU requirements for launchers. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Launcher Rigging skill.
31646.name: Medium Warhead Rigor Catalyst I

31796.description: This ship modification is designed to increase shield capacity at the expense of increased signature radius. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Shield Rigging skill.
31796.name: Medium Core Defense Field Extender II

31818.description: This ship modification is designed to reduce the duration of shield booster cycles at the expense of increased signature radius. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Shield Rigging skill.
31818.name: Medium Core Defense Operational Solidifier I

32014.description: Provides a quick injection of power into your capacitor. Good for tight situations!
32014.name: Navy Cap Booster 800

35657.description:
Gives a boost to the maximum velocity of the ship when activated. The thrust that boosts the ship, and the corresponding maximum velocity bonus, are limited by the mass of the ship that uses this module.

Note: Usually fit on Battleships.
35657.name: 100MN Y-S8 Compact Afterburner

42695.description: This compact bundle of active nanites can be loaded into a Shield Command Burst module and dispersed across allied ships to provide increased shield resistances.
42695.name: Shield Harmonizing Charge

42696.description: This compact bundle of active nanites can be loaded into a Shield Command Burst module and dispersed across allied ships to enhance defensive shield strength.
42696.name: Shield Extension Charge

43555.description:
This module can be loaded with a variety of Shield Command Burst Charges to project a field of beneficial nanites over fleet members, improving their shield defenses.

+25% bonus to the effect strength of Shield Command Burst charges launched from this module.
43555.name: Shield Command Burst II

45999.description: +5% turret damage, +5% missile damage, 5% vorton projector damage. Duration 30 minutes. A novel and powerful addition to the range of neural boosters available to capsuleers, the Agency's ‘Pyrolancea’ compounds introduce a temporary but highly adaptive neural lace into the user’s synaptic structures. This 'Pyrolancea' lace enhances neural centers involved in calibration of munitions payloads and weapons energy profiles on the fly during high-intensity combat. The increase in the processing available to the capsuleer means that payload calibration solutions can be tailored more finely and results in improved damage yields against any given target. Compounds with the Agency identifier are being seeded into target locations identified by the mysterious network ahead of sponsored operations. Entities occupying the target sites often collect the Agency's support drops themselves even if they realize what they must portend. The Agency’s novel method of supporting capsuleer operations is thought to be as much an experiment as it is an incentive for freelance pilots to take up the public contracts.
45999.name: Agency 'Pyrolancea' DB5 Dose II

85178.description:
These human clones have been engineered  by the Order of St. Tertimon for infantry combat, and are waiting for an infomorph consciousness transfer.

Warclone blanks are valuable pieces of biological equipment, and are in particularly high demand by the Blood Raiders, as they consider the blood of clones to be the 'purest' sacrament.
85178.name: Tetrimonic Warclone Blanks

96542.description:
This cerebral accelerator has been produced and distributed by the Deathglow Hunters in conjunction with their partners in the Blood Raider Covenant. When consumed by a capsuleer, this booster will increase the rate at which they train skills for a short time.

Volatile compounds were used to create this cerebral accelerator, limiting its shelf life. It will cease to function after November 10, YC128.
96542.name: Basic 'Radiance' Cerebral Accelerator

96553.description: This booster has been developed by the harvest fleets of the Blood Raiders to aid them in their sanguinary acts of piracy. +1km Webifier Range. Base Duration: 2 Hours Expiry date: November 10, YC128
96553.name: Harvest Webifier Booster I

96789.description:
This canister contains the blood of a human who has been subject to long-term exposure to Abyssal energies.

Item Traders working for the Blood Raiders will want to acquire it, those working for St. Tetrimon will want to destroy it, and the Triglavians will wish to recover it.
96789.name: Mutated Blood Sample

97685.name: Glorified Decayed Small Remote Armor Repairer Mutaplasmid Blueprint

5955.description:
Gives a boost to the maximum velocity of the ship when activated. The thrust that boosts the ship, and the corresponding maximum velocity bonus, are limited by the mass of the ship that uses this module.

Note: Usually fit on Battleships.
5955.name: 100MN Monopropellant Enduring Afterburner

5975.description:
Massive boost to speed for a very short time. The thrust that boosts the ship, and the corresponding maximum velocity bonus, are limited by the mass of the ship that uses this module. The sheer amount of energy needed to power this system means that it must permanently reserve a fraction of the capacitor output just to maintain the integrity of its warp containment field, and when activated it substantially increases the ship's EM footprint.

Penalty: Max capacitor reduced.

Note: Usually fit on Cruisers and Battlecruisers.
5975.name: 50MN Cold-Gas Enduring Microwarpdrive

10631.description: A tiny launcher that can carry a very limited supply of rockets. Not really intended as a primary weapon but rather as a cheap supplementary weapon system.
10631.name: Rocket Launcher II

10850.description: Expends energy to provide a quick boost in shield strength.
10850.name: Medium Shield Booster II

11993.description:
No cruiser currently in existence can match the superiority of the Cerberus's onboard missile system. With a well-trained pilot jacked in, this fanged horror is capable of unleashing a hail of missiles to send even the most seasoned armor tankers running for cover. 

Moving away from their traditionally balanced all-round designs, Lai Dai have created a very specialized - and dangerous - missile boat in the Cerberus. Many have speculated that due to recent friction between Caldari megacorporations, LD may be looking to beef up their own police force with these missile-spewing monstrosities.
11993.name: Cerberus

12058.description:
Gives a boost to the maximum velocity of the ship when activated. The thrust that boosts the ship, and the corresponding maximum velocity bonus, are limited by the mass of the ship that uses this module.

Note: Usually fit on Cruisers and Battlecruisers.
12058.name: 10MN Afterburner II

14047.description:
Focuses and amplifies the efficiency of shield boosting modules. 

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.
14047.name: Dread Guristas Shield Boost Amplifier

15593.description: Identification tags such as these may prove valuable if handed to the proper organization.
15593.name: Federation Navy Fleet Major Insignia I

15601.description: Identification tags such as these may prove valuable if handed to the proper organization.
15601.name: Caldari Navy Captain Insignia III

15660.description: Identification tags such as these may prove valuable if handed to the proper organization.
15660.name: Republic Fleet Private Insignia III

15673.description: Identification tags such as these may prove valuable if handed to the proper organization.
15673.name: Federation Navy Fleet Colonel Insignia II

15992.description: Identification tags such as these may prove valuable if handed to the proper organization.
15992.name: Imperial Navy Sergeant Insignia II

15994.description: Identification tags such as these may prove valuable if handed to the proper organization.
15994.name: Federation Navy Sergeant Insignia II

19231.description:
Boosts the EM resistance of the shield.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.
19231.name: Pithum A-Type EM Shield Amplifier

19406.description:
Obtaining a Deadspace Overseer's personal effects is proof that you have finished clearing all major obstacles in a deadspace pocket and decimated the leading figure.

Anyone that procures an OPE (from the pirates themselves, their bases or from guarded containers) can sell them to CONCORD or DED for a reasonable amount of cash.

CONCORD has rated Deadspace Overseers by the threat they pose to society and divided them into tiers that dictate how much a seller gets for their effects.
19406.name: 7th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects

19739.description: A battleship mounted launcher used for long range standoffs with other battleships, but less suitable for bombardment of deployed structures. Contains a huge missile capacity, but has a slow firing rate and trouble targeting small, fast ships.
19739.name: Cruise Missile Launcher II

20307.description: A kinetic warhead designed for use with heavy assault launchers. Heavy assault missiles can be fired at a greater rate than heavy missiles, at the expense of effective range.
20307.name: Scourge Heavy Assault Missile

22291.description:
A computer system designed for monitoring and guiding missiles in flight, thus allowing for superior effectiveness and lethality. 

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.
22291.name: Ballistic Control System II

22470.description: Command ships are engineered specifically to wreak havoc on a battlefield of many. Sporting advanced command module interfaces, these vessels are more than capable of turning the tide in large engagements. Command ships represent the ultimate in Command Burst efficiency; the boosts they give their comrades in combat make them indispensable assets to any well-rounded fleet.
22470.name: Nighthawk

23111.description:
Modulates the beam of a laser weapon into the ultraviolet frequencies. Slightly reduced range. Slightly increased thermal damage.

The delicate crystalline structures used in the manufacture of this advanced crystal degrade with use, eventually causing it to shatter.

12.5% reduced optimal range.
35% reduced capacitor need.
23111.name: Imperial Navy Ultraviolet L

24471.description:
A small rocket with a piercing warhead.

This modified version of the Scourge rocket packs a considerably stronger punch, but as a result is heavier and slower. This makes it very effective against larger targets, but markedly less effective against smaller and more agile targets.
24471.name: Scourge Rage Rocket

24477.description:
A small rocket with a piercing warhead.

A modified version of the Scourge rocket. It can reach higher velocity than the Scourge rocket at the expense of warhead size.
24477.name: Scourge Javelin Rocket

24495.description:
From its humble beginnings in tiny Minmatar design labs, the Scourge light missile has quickly established itself throughout the star cluster as a premier missile for light launchers.

A modified version of the Scourge light missile. Does more damage than its predecessor but the volatile nature of the warhead, and its powerful containment system, reduce both flight time and precision.
24495.name: Scourge Fury Light Missile

24501.description:
From its humble beginnings in tiny Minmatar design labs, the Scourge light missile has quickly established itself throughout the star cluster as a premier missile for light launchers.

A modified version of the Scourge light missile. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.
24501.name: Scourge Precision Light Missile

24513.description:
The Scourge heavy missile is an old relic from the Caldari-Gallente War that is still in widespread use because of its low price and versatility.

A modified version of the Scourge heavy missile. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.
24513.name: Scourge Precision Heavy Missile

24533.description:
The first Minmatar-made large missile. Constructed of reactionary alloys, the Scourge cruise missile is built to get to the target. Guidance and propulsion systems are of Gallente origin and were initially used in drones, making this a nimble projectile despite its heavy payload.

A modified version of the Scourge cruise. Does more damage than its predecessor but the volatile nature of the warhead, and its powerful containment system, reduce both flight time and precision.
24533.name: Scourge Fury Cruise Missile

24541.description:
The first Minmatar-made large missile. Constructed of reactionary alloys, the Scourge cruise missile is built to get to the target. Guidance and propulsion systems are of Gallente origin and were initially used in drones, making this a nimble projectile despite its heavy payload.

A modified version of the Scourge cruise. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.
24541.name: Scourge Precision Cruise Missile

24688.description: Having long suffered the lack of an adequate hybrid platform, the Caldari State's capsule pilots found themselves rejoicing as the Rokh's design specs were released. A fleet vessel if ever there was one, this far-reaching and durable beast is expected to see a great deal of service on battlefields near and far.
24688.name: Rokh

25715.description: A launcher intended for use on cruiser-class spacecraft. While assault launchers do not possess the sheer damage-dealing capability of regular heavy missile launchers, their blend of speed and attack power lends them application across a good range of tactical situations.
25715.name: Heavy Assault Missile Launcher II

26088.description: This ship modification is designed to increase shield capacity at the expense of increased signature radius. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Shield Rigging skill.
26088.name: Large Core Defense Field Extender I

26436.description: This ship modification is designed to increase the EM resistance of ship shields at the expense of increased signature radius. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Shield Rigging skill.
26436.name: Large EM Shield Reinforcer II

30013.description: A scanner probe used for scanning down Cosmic Signatures in space. Can be launched from Core Probe Launchers and Expanded Probe Launchers.
30013.name: Core Scanner Probe I

31646.description: This ship modification is designed to decrease the signature radius factor for missile explosions at the expense of increased CPU requirements for launchers. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Launcher Rigging skill.
31646.name: Medium Warhead Rigor Catalyst I

31796.description: This ship modification is designed to increase shield capacity at the expense of increased signature radius. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Shield Rigging skill.
31796.name: Medium Core Defense Field Extender II

31818.description: This ship modification is designed to reduce the duration of shield booster cycles at the expense of increased signature radius. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Shield Rigging skill.
31818.name: Medium Core Defense Operational Solidifier I

32014.description: Provides a quick injection of power into your capacitor. Good for tight situations!
32014.name: Navy Cap Booster 800

35657.description:
Gives a boost to the maximum velocity of the ship when activated. The thrust that boosts the ship, and the corresponding maximum velocity bonus, are limited by the mass of the ship that uses this module.

Note: Usually fit on Battleships.
35657.name: 100MN Y-S8 Compact Afterburner

42695.description: This compact bundle of active nanites can be loaded into a Shield Command Burst module and dispersed across allied ships to provide increased shield resistances.
42695.name: Shield Harmonizing Charge

42696.description: This compact bundle of active nanites can be loaded into a Shield Command Burst module and dispersed across allied ships to enhance defensive shield strength.
42696.name: Shield Extension Charge

43555.description:
This module can be loaded with a variety of Shield Command Burst Charges to project a field of beneficial nanites over fleet members, improving their shield defenses.

+25% bonus to the effect strength of Shield Command Burst charges launched from this module.
43555.name: Shield Command Burst II

45999.description: +5% turret damage, +5% missile damage, 5% vorton projector damage. Duration 30 minutes. A novel and powerful addition to the range of neural boosters available to capsuleers, the Agency's ‘Pyrolancea’ compounds introduce a temporary but highly adaptive neural lace into the user’s synaptic structures. This 'Pyrolancea' lace enhances neural centers involved in calibration of munitions payloads and weapons energy profiles on the fly during high-intensity combat. The increase in the processing available to the capsuleer means that payload calibration solutions can be tailored more finely and results in improved damage yields against any given target. Compounds with the Agency identifier are being seeded into target locations identified by the mysterious network ahead of sponsored operations. Entities occupying the target sites often collect the Agency's support drops themselves even if they realize what they must portend. The Agency’s novel method of supporting capsuleer operations is thought to be as much an experiment as it is an incentive for freelance pilots to take up the public contracts.
45999.name: Agency 'Pyrolancea' DB5 Dose II

85178.description:
These human clones have been engineered  by the Order of St. Tertimon for infantry combat, and are waiting for an infomorph consciousness transfer.

Warclone blanks are valuable pieces of biological equipment, and are in particularly high demand by the Blood Raiders, as they consider the blood of clones to be the 'purest' sacrament.
85178.name: Tetrimonic Warclone Blanks

96542.description:
This cerebral accelerator has been produced and distributed by the Deathglow Hunters in conjunction with their partners in the Blood Raider Covenant. When consumed by a capsuleer, this booster will increase the rate at which they train skills for a short time.

Volatile compounds were used to create this cerebral accelerator, limiting its shelf life. It will cease to function after November 10, YC128.
96542.name: Basic 'Radiance' Cerebral Accelerator

96553.description: This booster has been developed by the harvest fleets of the Blood Raiders to aid them in their sanguinary acts of piracy. +1km Webifier Range. Base Duration: 2 Hours Expiry date: November 10, YC128
96553.name: Harvest Webifier Booster I

96789.description:
This canister contains the blood of a human who has been subject to long-term exposure to Abyssal energies.

Item Traders working for the Blood Raiders will want to acquire it, those working for St. Tetrimon will want to destroy it, and the Triglavians will wish to recover it.
96789.name: Mutated Blood Sample

97685.name: Glorified Decayed Small Remote Armor Repairer Mutaplasmid Blueprint

35% reduced capacitor need.
257.name: Infrared L

25% reduced optimal range.
25% reduced capacitor need.
260.name: Xray L

266.description: A small rocket with a piercing warhead.
266.name: Scourge Rocket

267.description: An ultra-heavy piercing missile. While it is a slow projectile, its sheer damage potential is simply staggering.
267.name: Scourge Torpedo

448.description: Disrupts the target ship's navigation computer, disabling warping, jumping, microwarpdrives and micro jump drives.
448.name: Warp Scrambler II

1541.description: Monitors and optimizes the power grid. Gives a slight boost to power core output and a minor increase in shield and capacitor recharge rate.
1541.name: Power Diagnostic System II

2048.description:
Utilizes a combination of containment field emitters and redundancy systems to mitigate the impact of critical system damage. 

Grants a bonus to resistance for shield, armor and hull.

Only one Damage Control can be fit at a given time.
2048.name: Damage Control II

2117.description:
Emits random electronic bursts which have a chance of momentarily disrupting target locks on ships within range.

This module can be equipped to Battleship, Marauder, Black Ops, Command Ship, Hauler, Blockade Runner, and Deep Space Transport ships.

Note: Only one module of this type can be activated at the same time. Additionally, fitting a Burst Jammer module will disable interdiction nullification.
2117.name: Burst Jammer II

2281.description:
Boosts shield resistance against all damage types.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module, or similar modules that affect the same resistance type, will result in a penalty to the boost you get on that type of resistance.
2281.name: Multispectrum Shield Hardener II

2299.description:
Boosts shield resistance against kinetic damage.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module, or similar modules that affect the same resistance type, will result in a penalty to the boost you get on that type of resistance
2299.name: Kinetic Shield Hardener II

2404.description: Favored by many for its average capacity and firing rate. Useful in both fast attack raids and longer battles.
2404.name: Light Missile Launcher II

2410.description: Designed for long engagements between medium sized ships. Slow firing rate, but makes up for it with a large missile capacity.
2410.name: Heavy Missile Launcher II

2420.description: A massive launcher designed for extended bombardments of hard targets like battleships and stations. Contains a huge missile capacity, but has a slow firing rate and trouble targeting small, fast ships.
2420.name: Torpedo Launcher II

4383.description: The Micro Jump Drive is a module that spools up, then jumps the ship forward 100km in the direction it is facing. Upon arrival, the ship maintains its direction and velocity. 32014.name: Navy Cap Booster 800

Note: Usually fit on Battleships.
35657.name: 100MN Y-S8 Compact Afterburner

42695.name: Shield Harmonizing Charge

42696.description: This compact bundle of active nanites can be loaded into a Shield Command Burst module and dispersed across allied ships to enhance defensive shield strength.
42696.name: Shield Extension Charge

This module can be loaded with a variety of Shield Command Burst Charges to project a field of beneficial nanites over fleet members, improving their shield defenses.

+25% bonus to the effect strength of Shield Command Burst charges launched from this module.
43555.name: Shield Command Burst II

45999.description: +5% turret damage, +5% missile damage, 5% vorton projector damage. Duration 30 minutes. A novel and powerful addition to the range of neural boosters available to capsuleers, the Agency's ‘Pyrolancea’ compounds introduce a temporary but highly adaptive neural lace into the user’s synaptic structures. This 'Pyrolancea' lace enhances neural centers involved in calibration of munitions payloads and weapons energy profiles on the fly during high-intensity combat. The increase in the processing available to the capsuleer means that payload calibration solutions can be tailored more finely and results in improved damage yields against any given target. Compounds with the Agency identifier are being seeded into target locations identified by the mysterious network ahead of sponsored operations. Entities occupying the target sites often collect the Agency's support drops themselves even if they realize what they must portend. The Agency’s novel method of supporting capsuleer operations is thought to be as much an experiment as it is an incentive for freelance pilots to take up the public contracts.
45999.name: Agency 'Pyrolancea' DB5 Dose II

85178.description:
These human clones have been engineered  by the Order of St. Tertimon for infantry combat, and are waiting for an infomorph consciousness transfer.

Warclone blanks are valuable pieces of biological equipment, and are in particularly high demand by the Blood Raiders, as they consider the blood of clones to be the 'purest' sacrament.
85178.name: Tetrimonic Warclone Blanks

96542.description:
This cerebral accelerator has been produced and distributed by the Deathglow Hunters in conjunction with their partners in the Blood Raider Covenant. When consumed by a capsuleer, this booster will increase the rate at which they train skills for a short time.

Volatile compounds were used to create this cerebral accelerator, limiting its shelf life. It will cease to function after November 10, YC128.
96542.name: Basic 'Radiance' Cerebral Accelerator

96553.description: This booster has been developed by the harvest fleets of the Blood Raiders to aid them in their sanguinary acts of piracy. +1km Webifier Range. Base Duration: 2 Hours Expiry date: November 10, YC128
96553.name: Harvest Webifier Booster I

This canister contains the blood of a human who has been subject to long-term exposure to Abyssal energies.

expected.note: Rokh (real killmail 138993491, 2026-10-08, zero Abyssal fitted items) -- no turrets fitted (8x Large Proton Smartbomb II, fixed-damage only), 2x Multispectrum Shield Hardener II + 2x Large Shield Extender II mids, DC II + 3x Power Diagnostic System II lows -- regression guard for bug-class #17a/#19 re-audit (2026-10-08): Rokh correctly has NO SHIP_ROLE_BONUS damage/rof entry (it has no turret damage/rof role bonus in real EVE at all, confirmed via everef.net trait text), so dpsFixed is unaffected (190, drones only, unchanged before/after) -- this guards against a future session wrongly 'fixing' Rokh by adding a phantom damage entry. shieldHP rose from 114797 to 143496, exactly the predicted 1/(1-0.20)=1.25x ratio for Caldari Battleship's 4%/level->20%-at-V all-shield-resist bonus (previously entirely unmodeled, new SHIP_RESIST_BONUS mechanism). NOT a pyfa-client cross-check. UPDATE 2026-10-11 (comprehensive skill audit, P1-B): drone DPS multiplier corrected -- the RoF reduction previously applied (-20%, attributed to '[Race] Drone Specialization') was fictional, no drone RoF skill exists at all; that skill is actually a +10%@V DAMAGE bonus gated to T2 drones (reqSkill-detected), and a separate, previously entirely unmodeled weapon-size-class damage skill (+25%@V, Light/Medium/Heavy Drone Operation or Sentry Drone Interfacing, always applies) was added. Net real multiplier for a T1 drone is unchanged (1.50x1.25=1.875, same magnitude as the old 1.50/0.80 by coincidence); for a T2 drone it's 1.50x1.25x1.10=2.0625, ~10% higher than before. UPDATE 2026-10-11 (independent review pass, finding #2): maxActiveDrones (attribute 352) was discovered to be a CHARACTER attribute, not a ship one -- confirmed live via ESI's own attribute metadata and the absence of 352 from every checked ship's dogma_attributes -- so the old Infinity fallback was never actually a fallback at all; it was the value used on EVERY fit, unconditionally. Fixed to the correct fixed cap of 5 (MAX_ACTIVE_DRONES_SKILL_V, from the Drones skill's own description: 'Can operate 1 drone per skill level', assumed trained to V per this tool's established convention). This fit's drone bay held more than 5 combat-capable drones, so it was previously crediting more active drones than a pilot can actually control -- the corrected sandbox output (droneCount now exactly 5, greedily filled hardest-hitting-type-first, same already-audited per-drone formula) is the new expected value. Sandbox: droneCount=5 of 10 bay (5x Valkyrie II deployed, exactly saturating the character cap; the second drone type's 5 units get zero deployment), dpsFixed=129 (all drone-sourced, Rokh has no turrets fitted on this loss). UPDATE 2026-10-11 (independent review backlog #7, smartbomb-DPS-miscounting fix): this fit's 8x Large Proton Smartbomb II were previously counted as 0 toward dpsFixed -- classifyHighSlotItem() read only attribute 51 (RATE_OF_FIRE_ATTR) to detect a fixed-damage weapon's own cycle time, and a real smartbomb carries none at all (confirmed live via ESI: Large Proton Smartbomb II, type 3979, carries attribute 73=10000ms instead), so every fitted smartbomb on this exact killmail was silently misclassified as ammo and dropped entirely -- this fit's old dpsFixed range (123-135) was DRONE DPS ONLY, labeled at the time as correct because the smartbomb bug hadn't been found yet. Fixed: cycleMs now falls back to attribute 73. New dpsFixed = droneDps(129, unchanged) + fixedWeaponDps(8 x 300dmg/10s = 8x30 = 240, Large Proton Smartbomb II live-ESI-verified: explosive damage 300/cycle attr116, capacitorNeed 220 attr6) = 369 exact, verified directly against the tool's own sandboxed output. UPDATE 2026-10-12 (passive shield recharge fix): this fit's 3x Power Diagnostic System II were previously credited for their capacitor-side attr144/147 effect only -- their MATCHING shield-side attr146=1.05 (shieldCapacityMultiplier) was never read at all (shield passive recharge wasn't modeled anywhere in this file until this fix). Now pooled via applyStackingBonus (3 stacking-penalized +5% entries) onto the ship's actual shieldHP, correctly raising it ~12.7% (143496->161706, same ratio EHP and raw capacity move by since resistances are untouched) -- a genuine correctness improvement, not a regression. Widened range to 159300-164100 (was 141343-145649); totalHP widened to match (201000-207200, was 183135-188713). UPDATE 2026-10-13 (Energy Pulse Weapons skill fix): smartbomb cycle 10s -> 7.5s at V (skill 3421, -5%/lvl duration, pyfa Effect590). 8x Large Proton Smartbomb II: 8 x 300 / 7.5 = 320 DPS (was 240); drones unchanged 129; total 449 (was 369). Range re-centered on the new hand-derived value (still NOT a pyfa-client cross-check). UPDATE 2026-10-13 (v2026.10.13.10, unpenalized cap/shield pools): its 3x Power Diagnostic System II shield-capacity multipliers are no longer stacking-penalized (pyfa shieldCapacityMultiply has no stackingPenalties flag). shieldHP 162,0xx -> 166,114, totalHP -> 208,543; ranges re-centered (still NOT a pyfa-client cross-check).

sacrilege_zkb138990950_rolebonus_audit.label: Sacrilege (real killmail 138990950, 2026-10-08, zero Abyssal fitted items) -- 4x Heavy Assault Missile Launcher II/mixed Caldari Navy Mjolnir+Nova HAM, 2x Ballistic Control System II lows, Multispectrum Energized Membrane II armor hardener + Assault Damage Control II lows -- regression guard for bug-class #17a/#19 re-audit (2026-10-08): the live file already had a Sacrilege SHIP_ROLE_BONUS entry but its RoF magnitude was wrong -- coded 25%, re-verified live via everef.net that Sacrilege's Heavy Assault Cruisers RoF skill is 7.5%/level (37.5% at V) not 5%/level, corrected to 37.5. dpsFixed rose from 440 to 528, exactly the predicted 0.75/0.625=1.2x ratio from the RoF correction (confirmed on BOTH ammo breakdown entries individually: 264->317 and 176->211, both x1.2). armorHP rose from 35850 to 47801, exactly the predicted 1/(1-0.25)=1.3333x ratio for Amarr Cruiser's 5%/level->25%-at-V all-armor-resist bonus (previously entirely unmodeled, new SHIP_RESIST_BONUS mechanism). 203.name: Scourge Cruise Missile

209.description: The Scourge heavy missile is an old relic from the Caldari-Gallente War that is still in widespread use because of its low price and versatility.

2404.name: Light Missile Launcher II

9678.description: Radiates an omnidirectional pulse from the ship that causes EM damage to surrounding vessels.
9678.name: 'Vehemence' Compact Large EMP Smartbomb

10631.description: A tiny launcher that can carry a very limited supply of rockets. Not really intended as a primary weapon but rather as a cheap supplementary weapon system.

12015.description: Commissioned by the Republic Fleet to create a powerful assault vessel for the strengthening of the Matari tribes as well as a commercial platform for the Heavy Missiles and other weapons produced by the Fleet, Boundless Creation came up with the Muninn. Heavily armored, laden with missile hardpoints and sporting the latest in warhead optimization technology, this is the very definition of heavy assault.
12015.name: Muninn

12019.description:
Khanid's engineers have spent months perfecting the Sacrilege's on-board missile launcher optimization systems, making it a very effective assault missile platform. In addition, its supremely advanced capacitor systems make it one of the most dangerous ships in its class. 

In an effort to maintain the fragile peace with the old empire through force of deterrence, Khanid Innovation have taken the Maller blueprint and morphed it into a monster. State-of-the-art armor alloys, along with missile systems developed from the most advanced Caldari designs, mean the Sacrilege may be well on its way to becoming the Royal Khanid Navy's flagship cruiser.
12019.name: Sacrilege

28668.description:
A thick, heavy liquid, typically stored in tanks or container systems intended for liquids. It is composed of billions of nanites that can be programmed to repair damaged ship modules on the fly. The paste is simply applied to the damaged area, and the nanites meld into an exact copy of the damaged area, thus effecting repairs upon the module. This is a one-time process, as the nanites use themselves up along with the trace elements mixed into their carrier fluid.

The Repair Paste is generally only used for emergency on-site repairs. It is then recommended to have the damaged components looked at by a certified technician at first opportunity.
28668.name: Nanite Repair Paste

A thick, heavy liquid, typically stored in tanks or container systems intended for liquids. It is composed of billions of nanites that can be programmed to repair damaged ship modules on the fly. The paste is simply applied to the damaged area, and the nanites meld into an exact copy of the damaged area, thus effecting repairs upon the module. This is a one-time process, as the nanites use themselves up along with the trace elements mixed into their carrier fluid.

The Repair Paste is generally only used for emergency on-site repairs. It is then recommended to have the damaged components looked at by a certified technician at first opportunity.

46002.description: +5% Armor Repair, +5% Shield Booster. Duration 30 minutes. A novel and powerful addition to the range of neural boosters available to capsuleers, the Agency's ‘Hardshell’ compounds introduce a temporary but highly adaptive neural lace into the user’s synaptic structures. This 'Hardshell' lace attaches to synaptic pathways involved in fine-tuning field control at various energy levels, this allows an increase in shield booster efficiency and, through the low-energy fields that direct nano-repairers throughout a ship's armor layers, an increase in repair rates. Compounds with the Agency identifier are being seeded into target locations identified by the mysterious network ahead of sponsored operations. Entities occupying the target sites often collect the Agency's support drops themselves even if they realize what they must portend. The Agency’s novel method of supporting capsuleer operations is thought to be as much an experiment as it is an incentive for freelance pilots to take up the public contracts.

An enhanced version of the multispectrum armor coating. Uses advanced magnetic field generators to strengthen the effect. Grants a bonus to armor resistance against all types of damage. It is less effective than membranes tuned against a specific damage profile.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.
11269.name: Multispectrum Energized Membrane II

12563.description:
The Scorch is a UV crystal designed by Carthum Conglomerate. Utilizing AI microtrackers it gives a good boost to range but has fairly low damage potential, low tracking and is of limited use against heavily armored targets. The delicate crystalline structures used in the manufacture of this advanced crystal degrade with use, eventually causing it to shatter.

40% increased optimal range.
25% reduced tracking speed.

Note: This ammunition can only be used by small tech level II and faction Pulse Lasers.
12563.name: Scorch S

12565.description:
The Conflagration is a supercharged X-Ray crystal created by Carthum Conglomerate for the Imperial Navy. Has much greater damage potential than the standard version, but needs considerably more capacitor, has reduced effective range and negatively affects the weapon's tracking speed. The delicate crystalline structures used in the manufacture of this advanced crystal degrade with use, eventually causing it to shatter.

50% reduced optimal range.
30% reduced tracking speed.
25% increased capacitor usage.

Note: This ammunition can only be used by small tech level II and faction Pulse Lasers.
12565.name: Conflagration S

19015.description: This module uses nano-assemblers to repair damage done to the armor of the ship.
19015.name: Coreli A-Type Small Armor Repairer

19739.description: A battleship mounted launcher used for long range standoffs with other battleships, but less suitable for bombardment of deployed structures. Contains a huge missile capacity, but has a slow firing rate and trouble targeting small, fast ships.
19739.name: Cruise Missile Launcher II

20307.description: A kinetic warhead designed for use with heavy assault launchers. Heavy assault missiles can be fired at a greater rate than heavy missiles, at the expense of effective range.
20307.name: Scourge Heavy Assault Missile

24471.description:
A small rocket with a piercing warhead.

This modified version of the Scourge rocket packs a considerably stronger punch, but as a result is heavier and slower. This makes it very effective against larger targets, but markedly less effective against smaller and more agile targets.
24471.name: Scourge Rage Rocket

24477.description:
A small rocket with a piercing warhead.

A modified version of the Scourge rocket. It can reach higher velocity than the Scourge rocket at the expense of warhead size.
24477.name: Scourge Javelin Rocket

24495.description:
From its humble beginnings in tiny Minmatar design labs, the Scourge light missile has quickly established itself throughout the star cluster as a premier missile for light launchers.

A modified version of the Scourge light missile. Does more damage than its predecessor but the volatile nature of the warhead, and its powerful containment system, reduce both flight time and precision.
24495.name: Scourge Fury Light Missile

24501.description:
From its humble beginnings in tiny Minmatar design labs, the Scourge light missile has quickly established itself throughout the star cluster as a premier missile for light launchers.

A modified version of the Scourge light missile. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.
24501.name: Scourge Precision Light Missile

24513.description:
The Scourge heavy missile is an old relic from the Caldari-Gallente War that is still in widespread use because of its low price and versatility.

A modified version of the Scourge heavy missile. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.
24513.name: Scourge Precision Heavy Missile

24533.description:
The first Minmatar-made large missile. Constructed of reactionary alloys, the Scourge cruise missile is built to get to the target. Guidance and propulsion systems are of Gallente origin and were initially used in drones, making this a nimble projectile despite its heavy payload.

A modified version of the Scourge cruise. Does more damage than its predecessor but the volatile nature of the warhead, and its powerful containment system, reduce both flight time and precision.
24533.name: Scourge Fury Cruise Missile

24541.description:
The first Minmatar-made large missile. Constructed of reactionary alloys, the Scourge cruise missile is built to get to the target. Guidance and propulsion systems are of Gallente origin and were initially used in drones, making this a nimble projectile despite its heavy payload.

A modified version of the Scourge cruise. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.
24541.name: Scourge Precision Cruise Missile

25715.description: A launcher intended for use on cruiser-class spacecraft. While assault launchers do not possess the sheer damage-dealing capability of regular heavy missile launchers, their blend of speed and attack power lends them application across a good range of tactical situations.
25715.name: Heavy Assault Missile Launcher II

30488.description: A scanner probe used for scanning down Cosmic Signatures in space. Can be launched from Core Probe Launchers and Expanded Probe Launchers.
30488.name: Sisters Core Scanner Probe

31039.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's armor thermal resistance at the expense of agility. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Armor Rigging skill.
31039.name: Small Thermal Armor Reinforcer II

31171.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's agility at the expense of armor amount. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Astronautics Rigging skill.
31171.name: Small Low Friction Nozzle Joints II

31376.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's capacitor recharge rate.
31376.name: Small Capacitor Control Circuit II

33475.description:
The mobile tractoring unit takes some of the work out of looting the scorched ruins left by capsuleers, be it pulverized asteroids, wrecked ships, or obliterated inhabitation modules of various kinds. Once it has been deployed and completed its automatic activation process, it will lock on to any containers or wrecks within range, reel them in one by one, and empty their contents into its own cargo bay. All the capsuleer needs to do is keep up the pace of destruction.

125km effective range.
10 second activation time.

May not be deployed within 5km of another Mobile Tractor Unit, within 50km of Stargates, Stations or Upwell Structures, or within 40km of a Starbase.
Automatically decays if abandoned for two days.
33475.name: Mobile Tractor Unit

34317.description: Your first duty is to purge yourself in the flames of your confession before God. You must become ash in God's hands, for only then may you rise anew to strike the adversary down. -Apostle-Martial Zhar Pashay's dawn address to the Paladins at the Battle of Rahdo, Amarr Prime AD 20538
34317.name: Confessor

41212.description: Increases capacitor storage. Provides defense against Energy Leech and Energy Neutralizer effects.
41212.name: Republic Fleet Small Cap Battery

46002.description: +5% Armor Repair, +5% Shield Booster. Duration 30 minutes. A novel and powerful addition to the range of neural boosters available to capsuleers, the Agency's ‘Hardshell’ compounds introduce a temporary but highly adaptive neural lace into the user’s synaptic structures. This 'Hardshell' lace attaches to synaptic pathways involved in fine-tuning field control at various energy levels, this allows an increase in shield booster efficiency and, through the low-energy fields that direct nano-repairers throughout a ship's armor layers, an increase in repair rates. Compounds with the Agency identifier are being seeded into target locations identified by the mysterious network ahead of sponsored operations. Entities occupying the target sites often collect the Agency's support drops themselves even if they realize what they must portend. The Agency’s novel method of supporting capsuleer operations is thought to be as much an experiment as it is an incentive for freelance pilots to take up the public contracts.
46002.name: Agency 'Hardshell' TB5 Dose II

438.name: 1MN Afterburner II

2364.name: Heat Sink II

2404.description: Favored by many for its average capacity and firing rate. Useful in both fast attack raids and longer battles.
2404.name: Light Missile Launcher II

2410.description: Designed for long engagements between medium sized ships. Slow firing rate, but makes up for it with a large missile capacity.

4258.description: Launcher for Core Scanner Probes, which are used to scan down Cosmic Signatures in space. Note: Only one probe launcher can be fitted per ship. 5% bonus to strength of scan probes.
4258.name: Core Probe Launcher II

A modified version of the Scourge cruise. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.

25715.description: A launcher intended for use on cruiser-class spacecraft. While assault launchers do not possess the sheer damage-dealing capability of regular heavy missile launchers, their blend of speed and attack power lends them application across a good range of tactical situations.
25715.name: Heavy Assault Missile Launcher II

30488.description: A scanner probe used for scanning down Cosmic Signatures in space. Can be launched from Core Probe Launchers and Expanded Probe Launchers.
30488.name: Sisters Core Scanner Probe

31039.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's armor thermal resistance at the expense of agility. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Armor Rigging skill.
31039.name: Small Thermal Armor Reinforcer II

31171.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's agility at the expense of armor amount. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Astronautics Rigging skill.
31171.name: Small Low Friction Nozzle Joints II

31376.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's capacitor recharge rate.
31376.name: Small Capacitor Control Circuit II

33475.description:
The mobile tractoring unit takes some of the work out of looting the scorched ruins left by capsuleers, be it pulverized asteroids, wrecked ships, or obliterated inhabitation modules of various kinds. Once it has been deployed and completed its automatic activation process, it will lock on to any containers or wrecks within range, reel them in one by one, and empty their contents into its own cargo bay. All the capsuleer needs to do is keep up the pace of destruction.

125km effective range.
10 second activation time.

May not be deployed within 5km of another Mobile Tractor Unit, within 50km of Stargates, Stations or Upwell Structures, or within 40km of a Starbase.
Automatically decays if abandoned for two days.
33475.name: Mobile Tractor Unit

34317.description: Your first duty is to purge yourself in the flames of your confession before God. You must become ash in God's hands, for only then may you rise anew to strike the adversary down. -Apostle-Martial Zhar Pashay's dawn address to the Paladins at the Battle of Rahdo, Amarr Prime AD 20538
34317.name: Confessor

41212.description: Increases capacitor storage. Provides defense against Energy Leech and Energy Neutralizer effects.
41212.name: Republic Fleet Small Cap Battery

46002.description: +5% Armor Repair, +5% Shield Booster. Duration 30 minutes. A novel and powerful addition to the range of neural boosters available to capsuleers, the Agency's ‘Hardshell’ compounds introduce a temporary but highly adaptive neural lace into the user’s synaptic structures. This 'Hardshell' lace attaches to synaptic pathways involved in fine-tuning field control at various energy levels, this allows an increase in shield booster efficiency and, through the low-energy fields that direct nano-repairers throughout a ship's armor layers, an increase in repair rates. Compounds with the Agency identifier are being seeded into target locations identified by the mysterious network ahead of sponsored operations. Entities occupying the target sites often collect the Agency's support drops themselves even if they realize what they must portend. The Agency’s novel method of supporting capsuleer operations is thought to be as much an experiment as it is an incentive for freelance pilots to take up the public contracts.
46002.name: Agency 'Hardshell' TB5 Dose II

stormbringer_zkb138986635_vorton.label: Stormbringer (real killmail 138986635, 2026-10-08, zero Abyssal items) -- 1x Medium Vorton Projector II/ElectroPunch Ultra M x64, 3x Vorton Tuning System II lows -- regression guard for the NEW Vorton Projector weapon-system bug-class (EDENCOM's weapon, found 2026-10-08, same root-cause class as #18 Bomb Launcher/#20 Entropic Disintegrator). The Vorton Projector ESI/SDE group name ('Vorton Projector') contains none of turret/launcher/weapon, so it was invisible to THREE separate places: weaponCategoryFromGroup (fixed: added 'vorton' category), classifyHighSlotItem's own independent turret/launcher/weapon regex (fixed: without this, weaponItem was never set at all and the whole High-slot flag -- weapon AND its loaded ammo -- was silently skipped entirely, a more severe failure mode than a merely-null category), and getWeaponDamageInfo's identical regex (fixed, cosmetic -- affects only the 'last kill' damage-badge display). Also added: ammoCategoryFromGroup 'condenser pack'->'vorton', MODULE_DAMAGE_GROUP_CATEGORY 'Vorton Projector Upgrade'->'vorton', moduleDamageFractions/moduleRofFractions 'vorton' buckets (previously only had energy/hybrid/projectile/missile/precursor/drone -- a missing 'vorton' key here would have THROWN on any fit with a Vorton Tuning System fitted), categoryMods loop + isWeaponCat including 'vorton', and new MAX_VORTON_DAMAGE_MULT(1.25)/MAX_VORTON_ROF_MULT(0.90) constants for its own self-contained 3-skill tree (Vorton Projector Operation 2%/lvl RoF, [size] Vorton Projector 5%/lvl damage, [size] Vorton Specialization T2-only 2%/lvl damage reusing TURRET_SPECIALIZATION_MULT) -- confirmed live via ESI skill descriptions, NOT the ordinary Surgical Strike/Rapid Firing/Gunnery turret skill set. dpsFixed hand-verified against the live ESI dogma captured in this entry's own types/ below: perShot = ammoDmg(402 em + 379 kin = 781) * weaponDmgMult(attr64=1.2) * MAX_VORTON_DAMAGE_MULT(1.25) * turretSpecMult(1.10, attr184=54828 present on the weapon) * catMod.dmgMult(applyStackingBonus([0.1,0.1,0.1])=1.263858, from 3x Vorton Tuning System II's own attr64=1.1 each) = 781*1.2*1.375*1.263858 ~= 1628.67 per shot; cycle = 9s * MAX_VORTON_ROF_MULT(0.90) * catMod.rofMult(applyStacking([0.105,0.105,0.105])=0.764572, from 3x Vorton Tuning System II's own attr204=0.895 each) ~= 6.1930s -> dps ~= 262.98. NOT a pyfa-client cross-check (pyfa has no support yet for this brand-new EDENCOM weapon system), so pinned as a tight hand-derived range, not an exact golden value -- same evidentiary bar as the Vedmak/Entropic-Disintegrator entry.

54732.description: The Stormbringer-class cruiser was commissioned from Upwell by the New Eden Common Defense Initiative while the organization was still a counter-Triglavian strategy group headed by Provost Marshal Kasiha Valkanir. When EDENCOM was officially announced as the new central command for the defense of New Eden in YC122, the research and development of a line of ships capable of bearing radical new weaponry was widely rumored following Triglavian raids on Upwell development facilities. The Upwell Consortium had been working on adapting Arcing Vorton Projector weaponry to a ship-based form since the success of the technology as an anti-fleet weapon on Keepstar Citadels. The first Triglavian invasions in mid-YC121 spurred that effort on even before EDENCOM underwrote the project, providing access to scientists and engineers from the secret weapons programs of the four core empires, and even the SoCT. The Stormbringer-class is equipped with strong shields and is capable of striking from afar with optimally-tuned Arcing Vorton Projectors. Intended for use in rapid response cruiser fleets, this powerful attack vessel provides valuable flexibility in EDENCOM's war effort.
54732.name: Stormbringer

UPDATE 2026-10-11 (comprehensive skill audit, P1-B): drone DPS multiplier corrected -- the RoF reduction previously applied (-20%, attributed to '[Race] Drone Specialization') was fictional, no drone RoF skill exists at all; that skill is actually a +10%@V DAMAGE bonus gated to T2 drones (reqSkill-detected), and a separate, previously entirely unmodeled weapon-size-class damage skill (+25%@V, Light/Medium/Heavy Drone Operation or Sentry Drone Interfacing, always applies) was added. Net real multiplier for a T1 drone is unchanged (1.50x1.25=1.875, same magnitude as the old 1.50/0.80 by coincidence); for a T2 drone it's 1.50x1.25x1.10=2.0625, ~10% higher than before. Hand-derived: 4x Warrior II, thermDmg(20)*ownMult(1.56)*droneSkillDmgMult(1.50 Drone Interfacing x 1.25 Light Drone Operation x 1.10 Minmatar Drone Specialization [T2-gated, Warrior II carries it] = 2.0625)/cycleSec(4, no RoF skill) = 16.0875/drone x4 = 64.35.

expected.note: CONSTRUCTED fit, disclosed (not a verbatim single real killmail -- see label): based on real killmail 134562370 (Azariel, zKillboard) High-slot flags 28-33 (6x Quad 3500mm Siege Artillery II, all unresolved -- verbatim real data: real ship/weapon/ammo ESI type+dogma below) + its real Fleet Hangar ammo stack (Arch Angel Fusion XL qty 80, item 20743, flag 155 -- verbatim real quantity). Cargo intentionally OMITTED from this golden fit: the real killmail's Cargo hold ALSO contains Arch Angel Fusion XL (plus other same-category XL ammo), which would make cargoItemIds contain this ammo regardless of whether Fleet Hangar is read at all, masking bug #25 entirely. Confirmed via an exhaustive sweep of 292 real capital-ship killmails (all 25 current Dreadnought/Titan hull types that can fit turrets, up to 20 most recent losses each, zKillboard+ESI) that in EVERY real case where Fleet Hangar held compatible ammo for an unresolved turret, Cargo ALSO held compatible ammo of the same category -- zero clean 'Fleet-Hangar-ammo-exclusively' real killmails exist in that sample. This fit isolates the bug #25 mechanism using 100% real ESI dogma for ship (Azariel)/weapon (Quad 3500mm Siege Artillery II)/ammo (Arch Angel Fusion XL), with only the Cargo bucket of the source killmail left out -- same evidentiary fallback tier this project already uses for Vedmak/Vorton-Projector/Fighter-Bay when real data doesn't cooperate. Supplies a raw `killmail` field (instead of pre-built tally/highSlotByFlag) so this harness's own buildLossTally()/slotGroupFor() -- the ACTUAL fix location for bug #25 (SLOT_GROUPS previously had no flag-155 entry at all, so buildLossTally() silently discarded Fleet Hangar items) -- is exercised for real, not bypassed; see run_regression.mjs's `fit.killmail` handling. Verified by running this exact killmail shape through buildLossTally()+estimateHpAndDps() with and without 'Fleet hangar' in SLOT_GROUPS (reverted copy): WITH the fix, cargoResolvedWeaponCount=6/unmatchedWeaponCount=0/ammoEstimatesCount=1; WITHOUT it, cargoResolvedWeaponCount=0/unmatchedWeaponCount=6/ammoEstimatesCount=0 -- three fields flip. dpsFixed hand-derived and sandbox-confirmed exact at 0 (ammo guesses never contribute to dpsFixed by design). The single ammoEstimates entry is sandbox-verified exact at 7717 (hand chain: perShot = ammoDmg(88 exp + 17.6 kin = 105.6) * weaponDmgMult(attr64=11.34375) * MAX_TURRET_DAMAGE_MULT(1.4375) * turretSpecMult(1.10, attr184 present) * hullDmgMult(1+1000/100=11, Azariel's own SHIP_ROLE_BONUS 1000% projectile-damage role bonus) ~= 20836; cycle = 30s * MAX_TURRET_ROF_MULT(0.72) * hull RoF bonus(1-25/100=0.75) = 16.2s -> 1286.17/weapon * 6 = 7717) but not pinned here since ammoEstimates isn't itself checked by the harness, only ammoEstimatesCount.

expected.note: Real Vedmak loss (zKillboard killmail 139012125, 2026-10-09): 1x Heavy Entropic Disintegrator II (flag 30, loaded Meson Exotic Plasma M x476), 2x Entropic Radiation Sink II lows (flags 14/15), 2x Small + 1x Medium Energy Neutralizer II highs (flags 27/28/29, confirmed non-weapon via ESI -- zero damage attrs), 10x Hornet EC-300 ECM drones in the drone bay (flag 87, confirmed non-weapon -- ECM, no damage attrs), 3x Medium Ancillary Current Router I rigs (flags 92-94, confirmed non-weapon -- powergrid-only). Regression guard for KNOWN OPEN ITEM #1 (Vedmak had NO SHIP_ROLE_BONUS entry at all for its real, skill-based Precursor-weapon/Entropic-Disintegrator damage bonus): confirmed live via Vedmak's own ESI dogma_effects (effect 7085 'shipbonusPCTDamagePC1', attribute 2764=5 -> 5%/level) AND everef.net's rendered Traits text ('5% bonus to Medium Precursor Weapon damage' per level, a Type Bonus, unrestricted by damage type) -> 25% at V, added as SHIP_ROLE_BONUS['47270']=[['precursor','damage',25]]. Hand-derived expected dps: ammoDmg(90 therm + 150 exp = 240) * weaponMult(attr64=0.96) * dmgSkillMult(MAX_TURRET_DAMAGE_MULT(1.4375) * turretSpecMult(1.10, attr184 present) * catMod.dmgMult(applyStackingBonus([0.13,0.13])=1.257656, from 2x Entropic Radiation Sink II's own attr64=1.13 each) * hullDmgMult(1.25, this fix)) * spoolupMult(1+attr2734=2.125=3.125) / effectiveCycleSec(cycleMs(5500ms)/1000 * MAX_TURRET_ROF_MULT(0.72) * catMod.rofMult(applyStacking([0.06,0.06])=0.890988, from 2x Entropic Radiation Sink II's own attr204=0.94 each) = 3.52831s) ~= 507.27, matching the ACTUAL patched sandbox result (dpsFixed=507) exactly, not just within tolerance. Confirmed this golden fit actually catches the regression by reverting the SHIP_ROLE_BONUS entry and re-running the identical killmail through buildLossTally()+estimateHpAndDps(): dpsFixed drops 507->406 (exactly the predicted 1/1.25=0.8x ratio), both numbers sandbox-verified against the real tool code, not hand-derived alone. Drekavac's equivalent fix (SHIP_ROLE_BONUS['49711']=[['precursor','damage',50]], confirmed via effect 7155/attribute 2801=10 on the Drekavac's own ESI dogma_effects + everef.net trait text '10% bonus to Medium Precursor Weapon damage' per level -> 50% at V, also unrestricted) is NOT separately golden-fit-tested here -- same category/mechanism, verified via the identical code path (SHIP_ROLE_BONUS lookup + hullDamageMultFor), just a different magnitude and hull id, so this one fit's pass is a valid regression guard for the lookup mechanism itself. Zarmazd (49713) was investigated and confirmed to NOT need an entry: it's a dedicated Logistics-class hull (group_id 832, confirmed via ESI group name AND its own full description text) whose own dogma_effects (3172/3173/6374/7091/7093/7167/7171/7172/7173/12278, re-fetched fresh this session) contain NO disintegrator-damage effect at all -- correcting the 'likely Drekavac/Zarmazd' wording this open item was originally logged with. RANGE ASSERTION ADDED 2026-10-11 (tool-wide weapon range/falloff role-bonus backlog item, same fix as the damage-bonus one this fit already guards): rangeOptimalM/rangeFalloffM now also pinned at 53831/0 (same Heavy Entropic Disintegrator II + Meson Exotic Plasma M pairing as vedmak_zkb138993362_precursor, same 1.375x catMod.rangeMult, independently confirmed via this real killmail rather than the tally-format fit alone). dpsFixed unaffected (507, unchanged) -- confirms this fix touches only range/falloff, not damage. TANK_TYPE_THRESHOLD lowered 60%->55% (2026-10-12, the owner): this fit sits at 54% armor HP share -- just below the NEW 55% threshold, so it stays classified "Mixed" under both the old and new threshold. Paired with vedmak_zkb138993362_precursor (58%, flips to armor) to bracket the exact boundary (54% mixed, 58% armor) with 2 real, naturally-occurring fits rather than constructed ones. UPDATE 2026-10-14 (fixture refresh, tools/refresh_golden_fixtures.py): the neutralizer records lacked energyNeutralizerAmount; Medium Energy Neutralizer II = 180 GJ / 12 s = 15 GJ/s (SDE). Its capacitor now also counts the neut drain (unstable, 360 s) -- not pinned yet. UPDATE v2026.10.14.13: rangeFalloffM 0 -> 1. The weapon has no falloff attribute; pyfa reads the SDE default (1 m; LESSON #22) and shows 1 m (Precursor weapons 1.25 after Trajectory Analysis, Vorton 1.0 -- pyfa_fit_oracle). The tool read 0.
